tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams kyi skor rnams bzhugs so//

na maḥpra tha ma nā tha ma hā mu drā ya/ gang gis snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas ngo bos stong pa'i chos// skad cig mthar 'dzin yod dang med sogs rtog ge'i tha snyad gzhal bya yi// yin rlom 'khrul ba'i dri ma spangs te rang babs rang gshis ston mdzad pa// khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po mchog dang rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud// lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam rol gnyug ma'i gshis// thal phyir 'ol tshod smra ba rgyang bsrings te// ji bzhin 'khrul med rtogs pa'i thabs bzang po// nges don gdams pa'i dpyid 'ga' 'di na mchis// ༈ /rtogs ldan rgya ra ba dkon mchog bsam grub la gdams pa/ rtogs ldan khyed kyi nyams len sa mtshams 'dir// ngo sprod ma dgos skyong tshul phran bu zhig /dgos pa'i dus la bab kyi 'di skad lo// gti mug ngo bo chos skur rtogs 'dod kyang*// sems nyid bzo bcos bral nas sgom pa gces// de tshe bzo med ces pa gzhan med de// gang shar sgom yin de las gzhan du med// nyin mtshan dngos nyams gnyid dang rmi lam kun// sems kyi snang cha yin mod logs su med| |'gyu ba phra rags mang la de 'phral du// shar grol 'gro bar bzang bzang por mi 'dzin// 'gyu med yer sang gtad med gsal rjen yang*/ */sgom gyi snying por mi 'dod dad pa dang*// snying rje bcos min skyes na sgom gyi mchog /gsal stong sgom min rnam rtog mi sgom min// 'gyu ba gnyen pos bcom na bcos ma'i sgom// gsal la stong pa'i rgyas 'debs dran bzo'i chos// bka' brgyud gdams pa'i snying por 'di mi 'dod// dran dang ma dran 'gyu dang ma 'gyu ba// gsal dang gsal min stong dang mi stong ba// gnyen po dang ni gnyen po'i dran rtsis sogs// 'di zhes bcos med ma byas bya bral dang*| |gang shar sgom yin gsal stong rjen pa sems// rnam rtog des byas dran rtsis kyang des byas pas// byed po gcig la rnam rtog dgra ru 'dzin/ */dran rtsis grogs su 'dzin pa'i nye ring 'dis// 'khor ba'i 'phrang las sgrol ba dka' mor mchis// des na nyams len snying po 'di 'dra ste// gzhi dus sems nyid bzo bral chos kyi sku// glo bur lhan skyes dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// lam dus rang sems bcos min gang shar gyi// ngo bo bzo med lhod kyis skyong ba dang*// bzang la mi re ngan la mi dogs shing*// rnam rtog dran rtsis dbyer med gser dang g.ya'i// tshul yin re dogs mi dgos 'dzin med skyongs// bla mar mos gus yi dam bsnyen sgrub dang*// 'gro la snying rje bsod nams tshogs gsog pa// gzugs sku'i lag rjes 'jog phyir 'bad de sgrubs// 'khor gsum mi dmigs bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa// nyams len mthar dbyung gnad yin brtson par mdzod// rdo rje 'chang dang bram ze sa ra ha// dngos su byon yang skal bzang mchog 'dod la// gdam bya 'di las med pa thag chod yin// rtog ge log par zhen pa'i rna ba ru// tshul 'di thos na snying de gas nas 'gum// de phyir rtog ge pa dang don 'tshol ba// sman dang dug bzhin so sor 'dod mi mnyam// de skad smras pa rtogs ldan rgya ra bas// rtogs pa phul ba'i lan du 'bri gung pa// skya min ser min 'khor 'das rang sems su| |rtogs nas don gzhan 'tshol la mi re ba// chos kyi grags pas bris so nyams su longs// ma hā mu dra arthān/// /

༈ /mnga' ris dkon mchog dad pa la gdams pa/ dang po gnas cha mi 'ong ba de sems la 'khu 'phrig ma tshud pa yin/ slar dmigs rten la sems gtad nas 'gyu ba bkag pas zhi gnas rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra ba zhig 'ong*/ slar byung gnas 'gro gsum la sogs pa brdar sha phyogs sgor mo nas bcad pas gzhi med rtsa bral du go zhing*/ rnam rtog gya gyur 'phro ba de'i dbang du mi 'gro bar sems rang babs su sang nge sdod pa de zhi gnas rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su lhag mthong nya mo rgyug pa mthong ba 'dra zer/ 'gyu ba byung dus byung bsam pa byas nas gnyen po rgyag pa de/ deng sang gi sgom go chod po byed pa mang mod/ 'jig rten mgon pos ni de 'dra ba rnam rtog gi steng rnam rtog lhan pa brgyab pa yin gsungs pa red/ sems gnas 'gyu gang byung yang gang shar bzo med du skyong zhen med du bskyangs par byas na rtse gcig la sogs pa nyams su myong rgyu zhig yod tshod du 'dug /de 'dra tsho mi tsho la ni rgyus chen rang mi 'dug lags/// / ༈ /bcas pa sgrub chen ma'i rtogs pa phul ba'i lan du gsungs pa'i zhal gdams/ sgrub chen ma'i dge sbyor la rjes yi rang*// slar gegs sel bogs 'don phran bu 'di// rnam rtog la gnyen po brgyab pa de// sgom gnyen por shor zhes skyon can yin// rnam rtog nyid dge sbyor gsal ba'i cha// de stong par zung 'jug bzo med zhog /gnyid dang mngon sum 'dres pa de// nyams rtogs pa gnad du song ba yin// 'on kyang gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal de// rtsir gyis bzung la lhod kyis sgoms// gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi chos sku de// mngon sum du lag bcang zhig de na yod// rlung bum can bzung tshe brgyal ba 'dra// rlung dbu mar tshud du nye ba yin| |dus de tshe ma yeng ngo bor ltos// gsal stong rjen hrig gi ngo bo de// sems rjen par mthong ba de na yod// snang ba sems kyis rgyas btab na// sgom rgyas 'debs la shor ro de ma yin| |snang sems gnyis med du hrig ge ltos// don de tshe snang sems 'dre bar nges// chos kun gyi gshis lugs stong par smra// don de yang gshis la shor ba de// 'khor 'das kun sems su rtsal rdzogs pa'i// rang rig 'di bzo med so mar skyongs// 'dir tshig dang yi ge nyung mchis kyang*// gnad gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsgril// don chos sku lag bcangs su ngas gtad kyi// khyod skal ldan gyi snying phur 'di la thob// ces bcas pa sgrub chen ma'i rtogs 'bul gyi gegs sel bogs 'don tshig nyung don mang bar 'bri gung pa rang sems rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o/// /

༈ /slar yang sgrub pa ma de nyid la gdams pa ni/ sgrub chen ma'i dge sbyor skyong lugs bzang zhing 'bad brtson che ba de la rjes su yi rang*/ spyir sems ngo brjod bral gsal stong 'dzin med rjen hrig ngar ldan de nyid ye shes kyi gshis babs chos sku'i rang zhal dpyis phyin pa de ka yin mod/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes zer ba de ga yin/ gzhan pa'i lung rig pustaka mang po bshad kyang rtogs myong rang rgyud la skye rgyu de ga las gzhan med/ gnyid 'thug gi tshe dran pas bzung na cung zad har sad byung ba de 'od gsal rtsub zin 'ong du nye ba yin yang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam dge sbyor kho nar 'char zhing gnyid 'thug kyang dran pas zin la yul gzhan gyi mthong ba tshor drug gi go ma 'gags shing de'i lhad ma zhugs pa de ga 'od gsal gzhi lam dbyer med du song 'dug pas/ da nas bzung gnyid 'thug la rtsol bcas kyi btsir 'dzin byed mi dgos/ shugs kyis 'byung ba des chog /rlung bzung tshe brgyal ba 'dra la gsal zhing tshor ba ma 'gags pa de'i rjes su mi 'brang ba de rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa yin pas yun je ring la song na pho skyes rgyab/ de gas dus 'da' ba zhig byung na lus rgya grol 'phral chos skur grol ba the tshom med| de gas dus 'das/ ma 'das ci byung yang re dogs med par sngar rgyun ltar nyams su len pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus/ sems can la snying rje shugs 'byung du 'ong ba ltar gdung ba bskyed| mos gus ched du gtad nas ma skyes na rtsol ba bskyed/ shugs 'byung du byung na rtsol ba mi dgos/ snying rje'ang de dang 'dra/ bskyed rim thog mar gsal snang bton nas de rjes yin par thag bcad pa'i nga rgyal brtan pa tsam ma gtogs dus rtag tu gsal snang 'don mi dgos/ da lam gegs sel bogs 'don de tsam gyis chog /slar dgos pa byung na 'phral 'phral gsal cha mdzod/

'on kyang sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba de ga la bzo med du bskyangs pas gegs dang shor sa rang grol du 'gro ba gor ma chags so// zhes pa'ang sgrub chen ma'i bogs 'don du/ dbur smyon zhes padmas ming du btags pa skyu ra gog pos bris/// /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /yang de nyid kyis bzlas te zhus pa'i lan du gdams pa/ gang du tha mal shes pa zhes btags pa// rang sems ma bcos bzo med 'di nyid de// de yang bskyang bya skyong byed med pa dang*// 'gyu dran dag dang de yi gnyen po sogs// sgro btags bcos ma'i sgom gyis ma bslad par// gang shar mtha' bral nyid du la bzla ba// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i snying po nyid du go// rlung sems tha mi dad pa'i 'jug ldang gis// srog rtsol nyi zla'i rgyu ba rab 'gags nas// rlung sems mtha' bral dbu mar 'od gsal ba// zab lam rgyud sde zab mo'i snying po yin| |gnyid 'thug rmi lam mngon sum snang ba sogs// so sor tha snyad btags kyang ngo bo gcig /snang tshul mang po gnas tshul gcig po nyid// sad rmi mngon sum phyag rgya chen por grol// gzugs snang bla mar shar ba'i mos gus kyis// bcos min dad pas lam gyi sna drangs nas// dge sbyor 'bad med 'byung ba shin tu legs// de mus bskyangs pas dgos pa'i don chen 'grub// gang shar dran 'dzin bzo bcos bsres lhad dang*// gnyen po la sogs bcos mas ma sbags par// dran shes so ma lhug par skyong ba nyid// nyams len snying po yin gyi de ltar skyongs// dga' sdug re dogs med par nyams len la// bar chad 'tshe ba'i rnam pa mi 'byung zhing*// gang shar gang byung lam du khyer ba na// 'bras bu gang 'dod 'byung ba gshis las mthong*// bla mar mos gus 'gro la snying brtse dang*// gzhan phan sems bskyed rang sems bzo med skyongs// dge rtsa bsngo rnams chos kyi bcud dril ba// nyams len snying por gdams so 'bad par mdzod// ces pa'ang sgrub pa mas bskul ngor/

'bri gung pa chos dbyings rol pa rtsal zhes pas bris so/// / ༈ /sgrub pa ma skal bzang sgrol ma la gdams pa/ ji ltar sems zhes bsgom pa'i chos| |phyag rgya che la mtshan btags pa// dang po zhi gnas rab btsal zhing*// de la brtags pas lhag mthong gi// rtog btags nges shes skyes pa'i tshe// gnas shing 'gyu ba ngos zin la| |gsal stong sems su rtogs pa na// zhi lhag zung 'brel ting 'dzin zer// de nas 'phro na lhod kyis glod// bying na bsgrims shing rtsir gyin bsgom// rtag tu grim lhod snyoms par bya// gnas na de yi ngo bo dang*// 'gyu yang de yi ngo bor blta// gang shar de yi ngo bor rtogs// rnam rtog gang byung de nyid blta// de la rtsol bcas gnyen po med// gang shar der rtogs rang sar grol| |thams cad rang sems rtsa ba chod// bltas pas mthong ngo bsgoms pas rtogs// myong tshe grol bar 'gyur ba yin// bla ma'i mos gus rtsal du thon// byams dang snying rje dag la sbyang*| |de ltar byas na myur ba ru// phyag rgya chen po mtha' ru 'khyol// chos zad blo zad chos sku 'grub// don gnyis 'byung ba gshis babs yin// zhes pa'ang sgrub pa ma chung ba'i nyams len bogs 'don du| 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /yang de nyid kyis rtogs 'bul zhus pa'i lan du gdams pa ni/ sgrub pa ma chung ba'i dge sbyor gsal cha che zhing*/ rnam rtog rags pa skyon med/ mnyam bzhag las ma lang dus mnyam bzhag nyid gsal stong zung du 'jug cing*/ de'i mod la rjes shes 'gyu ba brang breng 'char yang*/ slar sems thog tu bzhag pas snga ma ltar gsal stong du 'char ba ni rjes thob ste/ de gsum rim can lhan skyes su nyams su blangs pas/ mthar mnyam bzhag rjes shes rjes thob rnam gsum dbyer med ro gcig sems don las ma g.yos pas| ting nge 'dzin du rgyun ring po mi 'gor bar 'gyur te rtsol bcas la goms pas rtsol med du 'gyur ba'i phyir de ltar 'bad pa gal che'o/// /

༈ /mnga' ris sgrub pa'i dris lan du bsrings pa'i zhal gdams ni/ mnga' ris sgrub pa'i dge sbyor dang mos gus sogs kyi gnas tshul zhib par 'byor/ dngos gzhi'i dge sbyor skyong lugs sogs snga sor rim gyis lab pa de ga yin/ 'dir mdor hril gyis dril na/ sgom med 'dzin med yeng med skyong zhes kyang*// da dung dug lnga'i rnam rtog yod dam med// yod na de dag sgom las gzhan du min// de nyid kha yan bskyang na tha mal pa// spang gnyen byas na slar yang rnam rtog skye// gang shar ngo bo bzo med skyong zhes pa// nan gyis lab pa ma brjed dang du longs// bla mar mos gus byed bya byed byed dang*// bral bar sems kyang da dung gnyis su 'dzin// yul dang yul can dngos po a 'thas blo// rtag brtan ther zug 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin// bcos min mos gus bla ma'i thugs yid dang*// rang sems 'dres na chos sku rtogs par 'gyur// tha mal shes pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun dang*// bdag gi nyams myong bsre bar mi rigs kyang*// rang gis nyams blangs rtogs tshod 'di yin te// gnas 'gyu rig gsum zhi lhag byung gnas sogs// zla ba ston pa'i mdzub mo spangs zin gyi// tha mal shes pa'i ming btags rang sems de// bzang ngan rtog pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral zhing*// bzo med rjen gcer me shel dwangs pa ltar// gsal stong 'dzin med dpe don go ba dang*// tshig las 'das pa'i brjod med rig pa de// ka dag gdod ma'i gnas lugs nga yis mthong*// de las rnam rtog bzang ngan ci shar yang*// chu dang rlabs ltar rang shar rang grol du// song ba'i ngo bo ka dag las gzhan med// rnam rtog ngo bo ka nas dag pa la// ka dag mdangs las rnam rtog ci shar yang*// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du// sems dang sems byung nyid du rang thag chod// nyi ma med na 'od zer ga nas 'byung*// tha mal rnam rtog sprin gyi phung po 'dra// rang sems gshis dngos nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dra// nam mkhar sprin dang nyi zla gza' skar sogs// du mar snang zhing res 'ga' ci yang med// gang ltar byas kyang nam mkhar 'gyur ba med// mkha' ltar rang sems dag pa tha mal shes// bzang ngan rtog pa nyi zla gza' skar dang*// sprin ltar res 'ga' 'char zhing res 'ga' dwangs// ji ltar byas kyang chos nyid las gzhan med// lus rgya la brten da lta'i chos sku 'di// bum nang mar me ji bzhin nang du gsal// lus rgya grol nas bum chag mar me ltar// rgya yan phyogs bral chos sku rang bzhin grol// de nyid bum pa chag dang ma chag las// mar me de la 'gyur ldog med pa ltar// rang sems 'di ni de ltar kho thag chod// lus 'di yod med don du khyad ma mchis// tshe srog lus sogs gnas skabs rten tsam du// sgyu mar snang gi don la zhen pa med// bar do ma dgos rang sems rang dbang 'dus// gnyis med zung 'jug gzhan la ltos ma dgos// gnas lugs don dam lung rigs bshad tshod la// re ltos mi dgos rang sems rang gis rtogs// ci byas bde ba kho bo'i nyams myong tsam// kun la ma smras khyod kyis dgos zer ba'i// ngo nan ma chog mdo tsam bris pa 'di// mnga' ris sgrub chen thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzod// ces pa gnas lugs rtogs pa gyi na ba// chos kyi grags pas mgyogs par bris te bskur/// /

༈ /mnga' ris sgrub pa ba'i yi ge tshigs bcad byas pa 'byor ba'i don de bzhin yin 'dug pa/ dge sbyor gyi skyong lugs sogs snga sor lan 'ga' yang lab pa de bzhin yin zhing*/ don hril gyis dril na/ sgom ngo mthong tsam nas bzung gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa ma zin gyi bar du gang shar gyi ngo bo la ched du gtad pa'i bdag 'dzin mi bya/ rnam rtog bzang po la mi re/ ngan pa la mi dogs/ gnas pa la mi chags/ 'gyu ba la mi sdang*/ gang shar gyi shes pa bzo med gcer yan/ der 'dzin 'di yin med par/ lhod de/ shig ge/ ye re/ sing nge bsgom/ gcig por sdod dam/ mang po'i dbus su sdod dam/ gang ltar byed kyang*/ sems kyi ngo bo ngos ma zin du mi btang bar rtsir gyis ngos bzung*/ rje mar pas/ sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// gsungs pa de'ang sems yengs ma lam du ma btang bar sems kyis sems ngos bzung ba'i don kho nar nges/ gzhan sems ngos bzung ba zhes nga'i sems 'di yin ang snyam du bsams na rnam rtog yin pas bsgom du mi btub/ sems kyi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas/ rjen gsal hrig ge mthong*/ de la 'di yin 'di min 'di byed 'di mi byed med par rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i ngo bo nyid de ka sgom yin/ dga' sdug rnam rtog nyon mongs na tsha la sogs pa gang ci byung yang*/ bsgom bya de ka las spros pa rdul tsam med/ na tsha lta bu la mtshon na/ na tsha'i ngo bo de gang las byung*/ lus na'am sems na/ sems ni stong pa nyid la na rgyu med/ lus bem po sa rdo lta bu yin pas na ba'i don med/ des na na tsha'i ngo bo la bltas pas/ na tsha dge sbyor du song*/ bogs 'don du song*/ rgyan du song zer ba'i sgom chen pa tsho don gyi nyams len la kha ma rag /don ma mthong*/ nyams su len tshul gyi gnad ma shes/ sngar bde mor sdod dus kyi dpyad sgom/ 'jog sgom yin rlom tsam des tsho ma thub/

'jig rten pa'i mdun du sgom chen pa/ grub chen pa zer ba'i ming snyan po de blos ma thengs| chos brgyad kyi blo ma zhi bas byed rgyu zad nas sdug thug pas/ na tsha de la rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas brtag dpyad byas pas/ na tshe sdug bsngal gyi steng rnam rtog gi 'khor lo'i brel ba de bsnan pas/ lus ma spangs par brel phongs sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du song bas/ lam 'khyer gyi gnad dang bral zhing nyams len gsor mi rung ba'i dug tu song ba kho na yin mod/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ lha 'dre dang*/ rnam rtog la sogs pa lam 'khyer med pa'i dus kyang*/ dang po gang nas byung sogs dang*/ rang gi sems las gzhan du med par thag gcod pa sogs la lam 'khyer du re ba ni las dang po ba tsam la goms 'dris bskyed phyir yin tsam srid/ nyams len dngos la rgyu mtshan gyis gzhigs nas sgom pa de 'dra 'jig rten pa'i kha 'chu lab pa ltar rgyu mtshan rtsa ba bkog pa'i khul gyis rnam rtog gi gnyen po rnam rtog gis byas pas/ log pa'i lam kham po cher zhugs pa rnams la ltos/ des na nyams len gyi gnad rdo rje 'chang nas dpal phag mo gru pa'i bar gyi lam bzang ma 'khyugs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa ni sngar bshad zin pa de ka yin/ dus thams cad du bla ma la mos gus/ yi dam la dag snang*/ 'gro drug la byams dang snying rje/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches 'dor len sogs rten 'brel gyi gnad yin pas shin tu gal che che/ gzhan pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don sogs da lam ma dgos pas sgrub pa snying por byed cing*/ kha bshad du ma song ba lag len nyams thog tu 'don pa zhig la 'bad 'bung 'don pa gal che che che/ zhes mnga' ris sgrub pa bas dogs gcod byas par 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris sgrub pa dkon mchog dar rgyas kyi dri lan ni/

mnga' ris sgrub pa ba dal 'byor la snying po len cing bsam gtan la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba de'i yi ge dang*/ sman ru rta bzang po'i rten ldan 'byor/ khyod kyi dri ba de la dngos gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems las logs su gyur pa med pa/ sems de'ang yod pa sogs kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ de'ang brtag na med pa'i mtha' sogs kyang med pa zhig ste/ mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes pa ltar yin/ nyams su len pa'i lam gyi skabs sems las rnam rtog 'byung ba'i phyir sems byung zhes btags la/ sems dang sems byung la yul dang yul can zhes sgro btags nas phyi rol gyi tshogs drug tu snang ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos dang drug po 'di la yul zhes sgro btags par zad/ de nas mthar thug tshogs drug sems kyi ngo bor dag dgos la/ de dag na mi gnas pa'i bde ba chen po zhes 'dod de/ bram ze sa ra has/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ lam gyi skabs snang ba zhes pa gzugs la sogs pa med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ smig rgyu lta bu/ tho yor lta bu/ chu zla lta bu/ gzha' tshon lta bur snang ba snang bzhin ma grub pa 'di ka yin mod/ 'on kyang mig gi yul du med bzhin snang ba ni snang cha/ dngos po der snang bsam pa ni rnam rtog yin pas/ snang ba dang rnam rtog gnyis kyi ngo bo rtogs pa'i tshe sems kyi ngang du gcig la/ rnam pa ma rtogs pa nyams su len pa'i tshe mi gcig ste/ dper na rnam rtog thol gyis skyes pa'i tshe rnam rtog der snang ngos zin pa snang cha/ gzugs mthong ba'i tshe gzugs der mthong ba snang cha/

de bzhin du sgra dri ro reg chos rnams kyang der snang de ga snang ba'i cha yin pas de thams cad snang char brtsis kyang*/ snang yul du snang cha de thams cad med bzhin snang la/ snang ba'i ngo bo rang bzhin ma grub/ ma skyes/ mi 'gag /mi gnas pa/ ngo bo stong pa yin pas snang cha de thams cad ngo bo tha dad med/ ngo bo stong pa de'ang nam mkha' lta bu stong rkyang ma yin pa/ khang stong lta bu cang med pa ma yin pa/ stong pa'i ngang nas gsal ba'i mdangs yod pa'i rang bzhin gdod ma'i 'od gsal zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis tha snyad tsam btags 'dug /yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ba rnams kyi 'dod lugs snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ snga ma las khyad par du 'phags pa tshogs drug der snang gi snang cha ma 'gags pa thabs bde ba chen po yab he ru kaḥ de'i ngo bo gdod nas ma grub pa rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa shes rab stong pa nyid yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ snang stong de gnyis dbyer med lhan skyes skye ba med pa chos sku/ 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul sku/ snang stong dbyer med gsal hrig rjen pa ngo bo nyid sku/ de'ang ngo bo nyid sku ngo bos mi stong ba rtag brtan ther zug zhi ba g.yung drung rnam rtog gi mtshan 'dzin gnyis 'dzin nyon mongs thams cad phar la gcod cing 'joms par byed pa/ ngo bo nyid de nyid rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin nyon mongs gang gis kyang tshur rdzi bar mi nus pa ye shes rdo rje'i sku ste/ sku lnga logs nas 'tshol mi dgos pa rang nyid la gdod nas yongs su grub pa krong nger gnas pa yin/ de nyid gnas kyang glo bur gyi dri ma ma rig pas bsgribs nas 'dug pas/ de bsal ba'i phyir gzhi la yod pa'i sku lnga po lam du byas nas bsgoms pas ma rig pa 'khor bcas dag pa'i tshe/ 'bras bu sku lnga po las thob bya gzhan med pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du 'dod pa ni nga gsang sngags pa'i khyad chos/

rdo rje 'chang gi bzhag pa/ skal ldan rnams kyi pha 'bab/ phar phyin theg pa las thabs khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ des na tshul de 'dra ba la thag bcad nas bzhag yod do ang*/ 'di las kha thag ring ba mang po 'bri rgyu 'dug ste da nangs 'gro kha yin pas mdor bsdus sa bcad tsam 'di mnga' ris sgrub pa bas/ rnam rtog dang snang ba gcig gam mi gcig dris pa'i lan du/ gnas lugs thams cad ngo bo zung 'jug ye shes kyi rdo rjer mthong ba dbur smyon chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bri gung pa'i khral gzugs can des bris pa yin/// / ༈ /mched grogs bstan pa rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ lhan skyes sems kyi rang zhal 'di// gal te nges par lta 'dod su// yod na kho bo'i myong ba yi// legs bshad dga' ston 'di soms shig |rang sems gdod nas dag pa 'di ko// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang du rtogs dang*// nges don legs par ston par mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la gus pas btud nas// bdag la bsgom bya sgom byed 'di zhes// nga bdag 'dzin rgyu'i blos byas med kyang*// grogs mchog nges don kho nar sems pa'i// gsung rgyun gzhan par bya ba bzlog phyir// nges don bsgom pa'i tshul zhig brjod na// thar pa thob pa'i sa bon dam pa// dmyal bar 'khrid pa'i lam gyi sna 'dren// 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rgyu rnams ma lus// rang sems las gzhan med pa 'di de// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes brjod do// de las ldog pa'i 'gong po zhes sam// sems dang rnam shes rig pa la sogs// rang sems 'di las logs su ci yod// 'on kyang de don ma rtogs pa rnams// sangs rgyas zhes bya bzang bzang 'dra zhing*// 'khor ba zhes tshe ngan ngan 'dra 'di// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa phyogs su lhung bas// sngar yang srid par zo chun ltar 'khor| |da dung 'khyams pa 'di nyid kyis len// de bas da lta dal 'byor thob tshe// sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad na legs so// sems zhes bya ba kun byed rgyal po// kha dog gzugs sogs grub pa med cing*// gnas dang 'gro 'ong skye shi med pa// stong gsal 'gag med rang gsal 'di ni// sems zhes bya ba'i tha snyad yin no// 'di la rang rig rang gsal dran pas// 'gyu ba bzang ngan ci 'dra shar yang*// de la dran pa'i gnyen po gtud nas// gnad du bsnun la legs par soms shig

/gang yang mi 'gyu zhi gnas lteng po// de la bzang ba'i tha snyad ye med// 'on kyang ngan pa'i sdang sems mi bya// rang rig stong pa'i gsal mdangs 'di ste// lhag par mthong yang gsal nyams dang bcas// bde bde 'dra yang bdag tu ma 'dzin// bde ba'i ngo bo de la rtsad gcod// de tshe dran pa gsal gsal 'dra yang*// le lo med par 'bad pas bsgom na// re zhig ci bya gtol med 'dra bas// dper na nor zhig rku mas khyer nas// gar song cha med de 'dra lta bu// 'ong bas de tshe mi bsgom snyam nas// blo yis thong la re zhig zhog dang*// bzhag rgyu med do rang mdangs shar 'ong*// de tshe rang mdangs 'gyu ba sna tshogs// shar tshe bzang la re ba med cing*// ngan pa la'ang ngan sems med par// dgag pa dang ni blang ba'ang med par// de nyid kho na'i ngo bor ltos dang*// de yi ngo bo rang gis stong zhing*// stong pa'i rang mdangs gsal bar 'char la// gsal ba'i ngang nas 'gyu ba 'phro ba// rang babs gshis yin dgag sgrub mi bya// rang sar lhod la ngo bor ltos shig /stong gsal 'di ste rang sems zhes bya// de nyid bzang ngan gang yang 'gyu ba// sems byung zhes bya de yi ngo bo// sems las logs su sems byung med pas// ngo bo stong pa'i rig pa yin no// rang rig rang gsal dran pa'i tha snyad// de yi gsal snang 'gyu ba'i rang rtsal// de yi ngo bo stong zhing bdag med// stong pa'i 'jug ldang chu zla lta bu// 'phral du snang yang ngo bor ma grub// byis pas 'ja' tshon bzung dang mtshungs so// de tshe rtsol bcas dran pa'i lcags kyus// 'gyu ba'i glang smyon gar 'gror ma gtong*// phyogs lhung mi bya lcags kyus bkol nas// rang sems bde ba'i mal du skyol dang*// sdod par srid do ma bsdad na yang*// glang po las ni lcags kyu logs su// mi 'dug pa ru rtogs par byos shig /dper na chu dang chab rom bzhin du// sems dang 'gyu ba tha dad 'dra yang*// don du gcig las gnyis su mi snang*// stong zhing 'gag med sems kyi ngo bo// tha dad 'gyu ba sems kyi rang rtsal// gsal zhing dwangs pa sems kyi mtshan nyid| |ngo bo stong pa sems kyi 'jug ldang*// de las gzhan pa su la yod dam// gshis la gnas pa sems nyid gnyug ma// stong gsal khyab cing brjod bral 'di yang*// logs su bltas pa'i snang ba mang po// da lta 'dra yang don gyi cha nas// rang sems kho nar blo thag chod cig

/kho bo'i phyag rgya chen po 'di ni// blos byas mtshan ma'i mtha' dang bral zhing*// nam mkha' dang ni rgya mtsho che dang*// sgyu ma nor bu la sogs dpe yis// 'phral du mtshon byed 'dra ru 'dug kyang*// don du de dag ma lus kun gyis// mtshon du med do rang gis rang la// mtshon tsam las ni dpes kyang mi rtogs// dbu ma chen po'i rang gzhan stong yang*// don du gnyis 'dzin kho nar zad cing*// rdzogs pa chen po'i rbad kham de kun// da dung mtshan ma'i kun brtags dam pos// bcings pa'i stong skad chal chol las med// phyag rgya chen po zhes su btags nas// thams cad stong ngo snyam pa'i med dgag /de yang sgom gyi mu ge zhes brjod// de 'dra kun gyi dgos pa med cing*// 'khor ba dang ni myang ngan 'das kun// rang gi sems su kho thag chod la// de yang stong pa'i ngo bor 'gyur zhing*// de yi 'jug ldang gsal snang sna tshogs// gang shar ngo bo stong pa'i rig pas// rang rig 'od gsal rjen par phud cing*// de tshe rtsol bcas 'og 'gyu'i phreng ba// sgom du rlom pa'i 'khrul mi rnams dang*// mi mnyam tsam gyi rtsol med dran pa// 'gyu tsam nyid nas ngo bos stong zhing*// stong pa'i ngang nas gsal snang 'char ba// de yang dran pa'i gshis sam babs bcas// gang shar sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul// sems nyid kho na'i phreng ba nyid las// gzhan du 'di zhes brjod du med cing*// nga bdag a 'thas ther zug chen po// nga yi phyag rgya chen po zhes su// bdag gir 'dzin pa'i nga bdag chod las| |bdag med rtogs pa'i gdan sa bzung zhing*// mthar thug bskyang bya skyong byed med cing*// chos kun rang sems kho na nyid du// snang ba du ma nyid du ro gcig /de yi rang rtsal ro gcig gang de// du mar shar ba'i gsal snang mang po// snang srid dpe ru legs par go bas// rang mdangs 'char ro de yang bdag tu// 'dzin rgyu min no de la dga' ba// ma skyes pa ru da dung de yi// gsal snang du ma'i 'jug ldang de yis// ma yeng yengs med legs par ltos dang*// nyin dang mtshan mo'i kun rtog rnams dang*// bzang ngan bde sdug phyogs lhung bcas pa// rang rang sar grol dper na tho rangs// nam mkha' rkyen dang bral ba lta bu// gang yang sgom zhes ci bya gtol med// stong zhing gsal la dwangs pa'i snang ba// rang rig rang gsal brjod dang bral zhing*// 'khor 'das ma lus gzhi thog 'di na// lam dang 'bras bu du mar btags kyang*// rtogs bya rtogs byed myong bya myong byed// gang yang yod med dran pa'i rang rtsal// 'gyu dang ma 'gyu tha snyad ye med// gnas dang 'gyu dang dran pa'i gnyen po// stong dang gsal dang ma 'gag snang ba// thams cad gcig tu sdom 'dra'i snang ba// zhar byung tshul du byung ba 'di tsam// kho bo'i bsgom rgyu'i snying po yin no// 'di las gzhan pa'i dang po byung zhing*// bar du dran pa'i gnyen pos legs zin// tha mar stong pa'i chos skur 'gyur ba// da lta bdag la bsgom rgyu ye med| |bdag gi nyams len zhar byung de 'dra// so sor thugs la 'dod mos byung tshe// 'di ni kho bos sngar nas bsgoms pa'i// goms pa las byung blo rdol min pas// khyed cag kun kyang yun du sgoms dang*// bsgom rgyu med pa'i rtogs pa 'di tsam// 'byung bar 'gyur ro thugs la bzhugs 'tshal// zhes pa'i stong nyid don du sgom tshul// lung rig mang po'i spros pa med cing*| |dpe cha'i stong skad myong rdzur ma byas// sngar gtam sna bsags yin rlom min par// rang gis bsgoms pa'i yon tan tsam gyi// byung tshul myong ba'i gnad du dril nas// mched grogs bstan pa rgyal mtshan gang der// kha ta'i tshul du 'bul ba 'di tsam// da dung rang gis myong ba'i gnad 'gag

/mang du yod kyang yi ger ma shong*// ci phyir zhe na nges don 'di ni// dpe ltas kha slob sngar gtam mang po// rna bar bzhag pa'i yid brtan tshig la// rjes zlos byas kyang gnad du mi 'gro// 'di ni rang gis bsgoms pa kho na'i// yon tan yin phyir 'bad pa mdzod dang*// myur du 'di 'dra'i don rnams rtogs so// kho bos sngon nas legs par bsgoms pas// da lta'i bar du skye ba'i phreng ba// mang du 'das tshe 'bad pas bsgoms pas// da lta bsgom rgyu med pa'i ngang nas// myong bas bris 'di dang du longs shig /deng sang sems kyi tha snyad tsam yang*// mi shes pa ru sgom chen pa zhes// khas blangs chen pos lus gnad bsrangs nas// hrig hrig mig gi lta stangs dang bcas// lag pa mnyam bzhag rkang pa skyil krung*// byas tshe bde bde 'dra ba'i sems kyis// 'gyu ba phran tshegs rtsol bcas dran pas| |zin zin 'dra ba yud tsam med cing*// yun du dran pa gar song med pa// ḍā ma ru las brel ba'i mgo bo// byi'u co ga bas kyang kha mang*// ci yin gtad med rbad kham byed pa'i// sgom chen rnams dang 'di nyid mi 'dra// de bas de don legs par soms shig /sngon dus rtogs pa phul phyin mda' bsnun// skye mang tha mar sna tshogs rang grol// da lta chos kyi grags pa'i ming gis// myong ba'i kha tar bris pa 'di ni// tshul bzhin nges don snying po len 'dod// deng sang 'di tshor yod pa mi 'dra// gal te yod na 'di don soms dang*// grub chen brgyad cu'i phyi rjes zin par// yun ring yod pa bdag gis ma mthong*/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /chos mdzad do bo sgang pa la gdams pa/ thog mar skyabs 'gro khyad par can// de nas byang chub sems la 'bad// dbang bzhi legs par thob pa dang*// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i rgyu// sku bzhi mngon du byed pa'i thabs// rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin bsgom// de nas de yi ye shes ni// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya// yod pa med pa la sogs pa// dngos po'i gnas lugs de la med// bsgom bya sgom byed la sogs pa// bsgom par bya ba yod ma yin// sems la dngos po ma grub pas// sems kyi ngo sprod ga la yod// tshig gi yul las 'das pa'i phyir// brjod par bya ba ci yang med// rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la// sems kyi rnam g.yeng ga la yod// dam pa'i don du de ltar yin// de ltar shes pa'i gang zag gis// de nas 'khor 'das bsre ba yi// spros bcas dang ni spros med gnyis// shin tu spros pa med pa yi// spyod pa gsum po rgyud kun las// ji ltar gsungs bzhin 'bad pas sgrubs// de ni rten cing 'brel 'byung bas// nang gi bsod nams kun bgrod nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba// bcu gsum pa ni tshe 'dir 'thob// 'khor ba sgyu mar rtogs pa yi// rnal 'byor dharma kīrti yis// snying nas blo gtad gus pa'i bu// chos mdzad do bo sgang pa la// brtse phyir nyams su len par byin// kha yan ma gtong nyams su longs// dge bas bla med byang chub shog/

//maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris skal ldan dkon mchog dad pa la gdams pa/ dad ldan dkon mchog dad pa'i rtogs 'bul la// gegs sel bogs 'don mdor bsdus 'di skad lo// zhi gnas 'thug cing brtan pa de yi ngang*// lhag mthong rjes mthun nyams su blang ba yi// gnas 'gyu rig dang byung gnas 'gro 'ong sogs| |rtsa ba chod pa'i shes rab kyis brtags pa// thams cad sems la sems nyid gsal stong dang*// gzhi rtsa bral bar mthong tshe ngo mthong zhes// gtum mo'i nyams len dus su bde nyams tsam// thun mong yon tan yin gyi mchog ma yin// lus kyang med nyams stong pa'i shes nyams te// bskyed rim gsal sogs gsal ba'i nyams snang yin// rmi lam drag zin res 'ga' rmi lam yang*// med pa la sogs lam gyi yon tan tsam// da dung bde gsal byung na bsam pa sogs// re dogs gnyis 'dzin cung zad ma spangs pas// bzang ngan rkyen rnams re dogs dang bcas pas// nyams len 'bad nas byed pa gal che'i dus// yin gyi 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya// re dogs bzang ngan rkyen rnams gang shar yang*// bzang la mi re ngan la mi skyo zhing*// gang shar rnam rtog ngos 'dzin mi dgos pa// de la slar yang gnyen pos 'joms mi dgos// gang shar de ka bcos lhad spang blang dang*// dgag sgrub mi bya gcer yan rang babs skyongs| |de ma thag tu chos sku'i rang zhal mthong*// bcos lhad mi dgos ma yeng rgyun du skyongs// ma bsgoms mi sgom bsgom bya bral ba yin// de phyir rtag tu yeng med bcos med sgoms| |slad nas 'gyur ldog byung na bla mar gtugs// dad pa dam tshig gsol 'debs 'bad pa gces// de skad ces pa chos kyi grags pa ngas// dad ldan mnga' ris dkon mchog dad pa yi// lam gyi 'khyog srong sna khrid kha lo yi// yi ge 'di bris chos sku'i mgron gnyer yin/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dkon mchog tshul khrims la gdams pa/

gnas lugs sems kyi gzhi rtsa gcod pa'i tshe// dang por ma byung bar du mi gnas shing*// tha mar mi 'gro skye 'gag gnas pa med// kha dog dbyibs sogs ma grub rang bzhin bral// yod med mtha' la mi gnas gsal zhing stong*// zung 'jug 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i gshis// gdod nas grub pa thabs shes snang stong dngos// gnyis med mnyam yangs rang bzhin mya ngan 'das// rab zhi 'jigs bral chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// skyon bral yon tan ye rdzogs phyag rgya che// ming dang 'dzin pa'i yul 'das dmigs gtad bral// de la 'di ltar sgom zhes su yis smra// 'on kyang zla ba mtshon pa'i mdzub mo ltar// gnas 'gyu rig sogs tha snyad btags pa tsam// thabs mkhas tsam la a 'thas ther zug na// gsor mi rung ba'i dug can nad dang mtshungs// de bas byung gnas 'gro dang gnas 'gyu dang*// dran pa gnyen po la sogs bcos ma'i sgom// gsar bu rnams kyi go bde'i ched yin gyi// don la rang sems spros bral ngo bo nyid// gang shar 'dzin mtha' bral ba khyab gdal dang*// ma bcos mi sems mi mno mi 'dzin par// rang bzhin rnam dag don la mnyam par zhog /ji ltar byis pas nyi zla mthong ba'i tshe// bcos ma med cing rang bzhin 'dzin mtha' bral// 'od gsal zung 'jug bcos min de bzhin du// rang sems ma bcos ma yeng dran 'dzin bral// rnam rtog mi dgag mi bsgrub spang blang bral// rnam rtog med la mi chags yod mi dgag /de la bcos lhad mi bya rang sar bzhag /ma yeng rang babs ngang du lhan gyis bzhag /lha 'dre bde sdug na tsha rnam rtog dang*// 'chi ba la sogs lam 'khyer ro snyoms kyi// tshig don mang yang de kun gang byung yang*// ma bcos mi dgag mi blang spros dang bral// rang babs gshis lugs lhug par ma yeng tsam// bzo med bskyangs pas rkyen kun grogs su 'gyur| |gnyid dang rmi lam la sogs nying 'khrul te// 'di nang 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod pa na// de las byung ba'i nying 'khrul ngang gis 'joms// don la de ltar yin no sems la chongs// de skad smra ba skya min ser min po// skyu ra'i rigs son chos kyi grags pa yis// dkon mchog tshul khrims zhes bya'i dogs gcod du// bgyis pa'i lan tsam mgyogs par bris pa yin/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rdzan thang chos mdzad la gdams pa/ rang sems spros bral chos sku gdod nas dag /ma 'dres gsal stong longs spyod ye nas rdzogs// shar grol 'dzin bral sna tshogs ye nas sprul// bdag sems sku gsum ngo bo nyid las min// gzhi rtsa bral ba'i rang bzhin rnam dag khams// glo bur dri sogs ming tshig rab mang yang*// lhan skyes ma rig 'khrul bas don dam bsgribs// ji ltar nam mkhar chu 'dzin rab dkrigs kyang*// nam mkha'i khams la nges par gos pa med// rang blo'i snang ngor nam mkhar sprin la sogs// 'dzin rtog las ni gzhan gyi 'khrul ba bral// sems dang 'gyu ba gnas dang gsal stong sogs// sems kyi cha re gnas tshul mthong ba na// deng sang rtogs ldan rnams kyi nyams rtogs su// khas blangs gzhan la bstan pas gnyis ka phung*// ji ltar gar mkhan mkhas pa'i gar gyi tshul// dal brel mdun rgyab stangs stabs sna tshogs dag /brgya stong khri 'bum rnam mang ci byas kyang*// gar mkhan gcig pus byed pa las gzhan du// rnam pa sna tshogs med pa de kho na// rang sems gnas 'gyu bying rgod gsal stong sogs// sna tshogs rnam mang gang dang gang shar yang*// gdod nas dag pa'i chos sku las ma g.yos// 'on kyang rtogs dang ma rtogs the tshom sogs// bya byed mang ba'i don la kha reg pas// snying por gyur pa nyams len gnad kyi 'gag /gang shar 'dzin med lhug par cham cham du// grim lhod spangs nas bzo med bde chen du// bsgom bya sgom byed med pa de sgoms shig /de las gzhan med chos kun 'dir 'dus nges// khyod rang lo gsum mtshams bcad mdzad nges na// gzhan du ma theg klu sgrub 'jig rten mgon// gang de'i sgrub gnas mthong thos dran tsam gyis// srid pa tha mar byed pa byang chub gling*// 'di nyid kho nar bzhugs na don chen 'grub// legs bshad gling sogs thal phyir rtog ge'i gnas// tshe 'dir ngal zhing zhe sdang la goms pas// phyi ma khab rtse'i zhing du chas rnams kyi// grwa sar smon na dal 'byor stong log yin// 'a cag nges don 'dzin pa'i bu rgyud la// thal phyir rtog btags kha mkhas don gol ba'i// bka' bcu rab 'byams chags sdang zhe sdang can// byung na seng ge'i phru gur khyi skyes pas// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i phung sri de las med// de phyir de spongs rang lugs dam chos mdzod// dgongs gcig dpe cha da lta 'dra 'os med// slad nas byung na 'bul ba kho nar nges// de skad kyang ni rdzan thang chos mdzad kyis// nyams dang rtogs pa phul ba'i gdab lan du// tha snyad spangs pa don gyi rnal 'byor pa// skyu ra'i rigs las chos kyi grags pa zhes// skya min ser min kho bos mgyogs par bris// sum mdo gzhung gi sgar du a kā ra/// /

༈ /dkon mchog tshul khrims la gdams pa/ dpal sems kyi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal nas// sems gzhi med du skyong ngo zer tsa na// gnas 'gyu la dga' sdug ci la dgos// sems 'dzin med du skyong ngo zer tsa na// 'od gsal mi rtog ci zhig bya// sems mi bsam mi mno zer tsa na// rnam rtog la gnyen po ci phyir bsten// sems yeng med du skyong ngo zer tsa na// ri khrod kyi sdug bsgur ci la dgos// sems mtha' bral du sgom mo zer tsa na// skyid sdug gi spang blang ci la dgos// gang dgos med kyi don la spyod tsa na// sems bzo med lhug par cham gyis skyongs// gnyen po dang zlo sgom la zla sogs// spros bcas kyi tsab tsub kha na med// re dogs dang gnyis 'dzin ma zhig na// ri khrod dang sgom thag mig hrig hrig /chos brgyad las ma 'das skyug re bro// 'khor 'das la re dogs ma mchis shing*// rnam rtog la der 'dzin med pa dang*// gang shar chos nyid du grol tsa na// grong gseb tu bsdad kyang rdo rje 'chang*// don de las go log gi sgom chen tsho// dgon pa dang dben gnas gar bsdad kyang*// 'gro don dang grub rtags ci bstan kyang*// grub chen dang rtogs ldan gang btags kyang*// zog po tshul 'chos kyi na bza' can// sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i phung 'dre'o// sems can rnams bslu ba'i snying phod can// rdo rje dmyal khams kyi tshogs dpon yin// don de skad chos kyi grags pa ngas// khyod dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis bskul ba'i ngor// gnas sum mdo gzhung du bris pa yin/// / ༈ /sgrub pa ma ngag dbang dbang mo la gdams pa/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ngag dbang dbang mo zhes bya bas// don snying po bsgoms pa'i nyams rtogs kyi// tshig 'dri ba'i lan la 'di skad lo// pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung du// chos zab mo zhus nas sgom pa'i tshe// sems rnam rtog sngar bas 'phro rgod sogs// sna tshogs kyi rtsub 'gyur ston pa de// sngar rnam rtog kha yan btang pa'i mur// dus de tshe bcur nas sgom bsgoms pas// gnong can dang yus can 'phrad pa ltar// rang mtshang mthong ba'i 'phro rgod de// gnas pa dang po ru gong mas bzhed// slar de rjes rnam rtog med pa ltar// sems 'chal 'chal ngos bzung med pa de// zhi gnas kyi bsam gtan yin par 'dod// skyong bsam yang skyong rgyu med pa la// 'gyu bsam yang 'gyu rgyu med pa'i ngang*// sems gsal stong tshor drug mi 'gag pa// de lhag mthong gi ye shes nyi tshe ba// dus re zhig dran med du brgyal snyam pa| |rlung dbu mar zhugs pa kho na yin// nyin mtshan mi shes gsal nyams can// don de ni snang nyams lam gyi rtags// de na bun ltar yal ba gdon grib dang*// zas bcud chen gyi ma yin bsgoms pa'i mthu// nyams de 'dra dag pa'i shul de na// dran pa dang dran pa'i ngo bo dang*// rnam rtog dang gnyen po la sogs pa'i// ming du mar btags kyang 'dzin med kyi// sems gsal stong ngos bzung bral ba la// skye 'gag mtha' bral gyi rjen hrig de// sems ngo bo mthong ba'i bsam gtan yin// de bzo med du skyong ba sgom gyi gnad// rnam rtog dang dran rtsis la sogs pa| |spang gnyen la 'dzin chags zhugs pa'i sgom// phyogs lhung gi 'khyog 'gros mi byed par// 'gyu ba dang mi 'gyu gang yin yang*// gang shar de mi dgag mi bsgrub cing*// bcas bcos dang re dogs mi byed par// bzo med du ma yeng 'bad pas skyongs// gnad 'di ni drang po'i lam du nges// don de skad ngag dbang dbang mo yis// mi bdag la dris pa'i lan 'debs su// sems chos skur rtogs pa'i sngags pa ni// ming chos kyi grags pa zhes pas bris/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rnam rtog skyes na gang skyes rjes ma bcad par chu la rdo brgyab pa lta bu/ rnam rtog med na med thog tu lhod grol mar me sbar ba lta bu/ lus bya byed dang bral ba dur khrod kyi mi ro lta bu/ ngag bcos ma med pa ri brag gi rlung sgra lta bu/ yid tsab tsub med pa rlabs dang bral ba'i rgya mtsho lta bu/ 'bol le/ shig ge/ lhod de bzhag /de las gzhan pa'i nyams bzang po skyes su re ba dang ma skyes kyi dogs pa sogs gtan nas mi bya/ nyams rtogs bzang po ma skyes kyang bzod| gol shor du yong yang bzod/ gang byung ci yong rang shog /don hril gyis dril ba la/ 'khor 'das skyid sdug legs nyes 'di thams cad sems nyid kyi rol pa yin par thag chod/ sems ni 'dzin med/ gnas med/ skye med/ 'gro med/ 'ong med nam mkha' lta bu yin pas gang gis kyang bsgyur du med par thag bcad pa la 'jog pa gal che che/ lar re dogs 'di 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rtsa ba gcig pu lta bu yin pas/ nyams len thag gcod kyi rtsa ba ni bzang la mi re/ ngan la mi dogs/ gang byung de gas chog pa'i zhe gdeng dang ldan pa zhig gal che ba yin pas dgongs bzhugs mdzod/ ces dang*/ ji ltar nyi zla'i zer la phar bltas pas// gsal phyogs 'od kyi snang bas stong gsum khengs// de la dpyad tshe dngos med gzugs la grub// de nyid stong phyogs yin par shes dgos la// de bzhin sems kyi gsal stong phyogs dag la// bskyed rdzogs ming btags de 'bras grub pa'i tshe// gsal phyogs gzugs sku stong phyogs chos sku ste// sku gnyis zung 'jug gnad 'di go ba'i tshe// 'khor 'das chos kun mkha' la nyi shar 'dra// skad cig rtogs grol skya min ser min ngas// nyams dga' blo bde nyams len 'tshol ma dgos// khyod kyang gnad 'di go tshe 'ching ba 'grol// de 'dra rtogs na tshe 'di phyi ma dang*// bar do la sogs de ring sang bzhin du// dka' las mi gda' shi gson khyad ma mchis// de skad smra ba dbur stod 'bri gung pa// chos kyi grags pas rang nyams yi ger bris// gnas lugs rtogs 'dod yod na 'di nyid soms// ming gi rtogs ldan ming gi grub chen pa// gson dga' shi sdug rnam rtog dgra ru 'dzin// rnam rtog med pa'i ting 'dzin la dga' ba'i// ring lugs rnams dang kho bo rgyab 'gal yin/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /bla ma 'od sding pa la gdams pa/ bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// mchog gsum dam pa rnams la gus btud nas// 'od sding bla mas bskul ba'i bslab bya zhig /rang la med kyang btsal nas 'di ru bris// ji ltar u duṃ wā ra lta bu yin// rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i dal 'byor thob pa'i tshe// mi rtag 'chi bsam 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgoms// dkar nag rgyu las 'bras bu bde sdug smin// dkar po'i las kyis thar pa'i yon tan 'grub// skyabs gsum bla mar bcas la blo gtad nas// sems can don phyir skyabs 'gro 'bad nas bya// de yi bslab bya srung zhing 'gro sgrol slad// smon 'jug byang sems sgom zhing blo yang sbyang*// sems can kun la brtse sems 'bral med bya// sbyin sogs phar phyin drug po gang 'grub bgyi// ma grub pa rnams re zhig mos pa bya// lam gyi snying po rdo rje theg pa yin// nyams len smin byed dbang gis rgyud sbyangs nas// gdod nas grub pa gsal btab yi dam lha// rnam gsal dag dran nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang*// bzlas pa la 'bad phra dang rags pa yi// rdzogs rim sgom zhing bla mar mos gus bskyed// nges don bden pa phyag rgya chen po zhes// snang bcas chos nyid snang med dag pa'i dngos// gdod nas yod ma myong la 'khrul bar grub// brjod las 'das kyang brjod pa mtha' yas pa// sgra tshig mang la ngo bo nyid med pa// ma grub grub min bden pa stong pa la// chu nang zla ba ji bzhin stong zhing snang*// snang ba'i ngo bo rang mtshang mthong bas stong*// stong pa ma yin gsal la ngar dang ldan// yod par ma mthong 'dzin snang blo las 'das// rang gis bltas na mthong zhing mthong bya bral// gzhan la ston na ston rgyu cang mi snang*// mi snang ba de bstan pas kho yang grol// med par thag chod yod pa'i snying por song*// yod ma myong ba'i dpe don yul las 'das// brjod rgyu zad pas 'di las 'bri rgyu med// gang shar blo 'das ci yang bzo ma dgos// re dogs dgag sgrub yin min la sogs pa'i// go yul lung rig bshad pa byed ma dgos// gang shar bzo med byis pa'i rmi lam bzhin// lhod min bzhag nas 'dzin stangs ma byas shing*// yin min rtog dpyod med cing ma yeng bar// nyams len snying po 'di las bdag la med// gzhan la 'dug na rtsol sgrub e dgos gzigs// nyams len kun mthar 'khor gsum dag pa yi// bsngo bas rgyas gdab lam 'di mchog tu gyur// de skad ces pa 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs// gnas lugs rtogs pa chos kyi grags pa ngas// 'od sding bla mas bskul phyir mgyogs par bris// rtogs ldan yin rlom rnams dang ma mthun yang*// de rjes ma 'brang rang thag rang gis chod/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /dge slong ra khyim par gdams pa/ lags/ gsung bris de la zhu lan thung tsam zhig ma phul na/ bdag sngags pa rgan po yin pas ma 'thus lags/ de'ang*| lus lha skur gsal ba snang stong la// 'ja' tshon kho na'i dper bsgom na// rgyu 'byung bzhis bskyed pa'i 'ja' tshon de// slar rjes med du song 'dra'i bskyed rim gyis// lus sprul sku'i sa bon ci la thebs// ngag grag stong brag cha kho na'i sgra// don snying po byas kyang brag cha de// rgyu dang rkyen la rag las pas// rgyu rkyen med par de mi 'byung*// ngag longs sku'i sa bon ci la thebs// sems phyag rgya chen por bzung bzung nas// don 'dzin med 'dzin pa'i sgrog gis bcings// 'dzin stangs can gyi phyag chen de// sems chos sku'i sa bon ci la thebs// nga sngags pa rgan pos 'di ltar bsgom// lus yi dam gdan gsum ldan pa de// sgyu ma'i dpe yis mi mtshon te// lha sku gzhom med sprul pa'i sku// slar gsal 'debs ma dgos gdod nas grub// ngag brag cha grag stong ltar ma dgos// don srog rtsol gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs// rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa spros dang bral// don bzo bcos mi dgos gdod nas grub// sems spros pa'i dpe dang bral ba la// dbu phyag rdzogs gsum 'dogs mi dgos// don rang ngo rang shes ye nas grol// sems chos skur krong nger gdod nas grub// he he sku rtsed zhus pa yin no/// / ༈ /yang gsung bris 'byor don/ nga sngags pa rgan po rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ ngag grag stong gzhom med rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems 'od gsal bde ba chen po spros pa'i mtshan ma dang bral bas na rgyu tsha rgyu mi gda'/ 'on kyang sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung po dang zag bcas kyi snyigs ma cung zad lus pa 'di rnam smin tsam gyi lus su 'dug pas na rgyu tsha rgyu 'dug kyang mdang de ring bde mo rang byung lags/

a kyang sku rtsed zhus pa yin/ da ni sngags pa rgan po bcos nas rgan po byis pa'i dus su slebs pa'i chos gtam red lags he he/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dol pa sgrub chen ma chos ldan mtsho mo la gdams pa/ dol pa sgrub chen ma chos ldan mtsho mo'i nyams rtogs kyi 'bul ba de bzhin la/ gegs sel bogs 'don cung zad cig rang gi nyams kyis smra na/ spyir gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi sems shes bya rang ngo shes par byed pa'i thabs kho na la/ rgyal bas chos 'khor rim pa gsum rdo rje theg pa dang bcas pa rgya cher gsungs pa rnams don 'di kho na'i thog tu 'bab pa yin/ de'ang lam gyi 'gros so sor khyad par gyi phyag chen gtso bo nyams su len pa dag gis thog mar sems 'khrul rtog gi g.yeng ba ngal gso zhing gnas par byed pa la zhi gnas sam rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin rjes mthun pa bsgoms nas/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin nyi tshe ba rgyud la skyes na/ de'i ngo bo mthong ba'i slad du byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs la brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes mthun pa tsam rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi ye shes dpyis phyin pa min yang*/ de ltar brtags nas gnas 'gyu thams cad sems su go ba'i tshe zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin nyi tshe ba yin pas slar ngo bo bzo med du bskyangs pas/ rtse gcig nas sgom med kyi bar sgro btags pa'i yon tan thams cad rang rgyud la skye ba yin la/ sngags lam steng sgo gtso bor byas na bskyed rim la gsal snang thon pas stong lta tshar bcad/ bsdu rim la myong ba thon pas rtag lta yul phud/ de dang gnyis med dbyer med bde chen gyi ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i don bsgom pa la gtum mo sogs nyams su blangs pas mthar bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rtogs pa na de'i rtsal sbyong 'od gsal sogs nyams su blang ba yin la/ don hril gyis dril na/

gzhi zhes skye ba med pa la/ lam zhes 'gag pa med par nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu re dogs spangs pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ phyag chen kho na'i skabs rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par zin pa nas/ rmi lam du mi 'khrul ba nyin snang dang khyad med du sgom bsam du cham 'gro ba zhig gal che/ sngags lam ltar na rmi lam mnyam bzhag tu 'gro ba las 'dzin sgyur sprul sbyang byas pas sa chod che ba yin/ rnam pa kun tu re dogs byung yang*/ re na re ba de ka la spang blang bcos lhad dgag sgrub mi byed par bzo med gcer yan 'dzin cha ma zhugs par bskyangs pas/ re ba skye ba de ka'i ngo bo mnyam bzhag yin pas de ka'i ngang du grol ba zhig 'ong*/ des rigs bsgres nas dogs pa skyid sdug na tsha lha 'dre 'chi ba rnam rtog thams cad la tshul de ka rang sgom pa kho na yin/ sems kyi dogs cha la 'dzin pa zhugs pa dang 'phrig tshud pa gnyis mi 'dra bas 'dzin med kyi ngang nas rnam rtog 'phrig tshud pa zhig dgos/ 'phrig tshud pa de'ang bcos ma'i khu 'phrig min par rang ngo shes pa'i 'phrig tshud pa de yin/ don dril na gzhi lam thams cad du ma yeng zhing ma bcos par nyi ma nam mkha' la shar ba ltar skye 'gag dang bral ba'i rang sems la gzung 'dzin ngo bos stong pa'i rnam rtog gang shar yang re dogs dang bral bar skyong ba de ka yin/ skyong tshul 'di ngo sprod kyi bla ma de mus pa rnams dang mi mthun yang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin pas thugs kyi gting du 'jog pa gal che che che/ zhes pa'ang dol pa sgrub chen ma chos ldan mtsho mo'i gegs sel bogs 'don du/ 'bri gung pa skya min ser min chos sku kha bshad dang myong ba de mus la mi re ba'i rnal 'byor pa chos kyi grags pas mgyogs par bris/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris rgyal sras la gdams pa/ skyabs mchog gsum kun 'dus 'bri gung pa// don rdo rje'i sangs rgyas de 'chang dbang*// phyi gzhan nas ma 'tshol rang la rdzogs// don nges pa'i bla ma des bdag skyobs// mi bdag la nyams myong gnad med kyang*// pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i pha 'bab kyis// don 'di ltar yin blo'i skad cha yod// sems bzo med rang babs skyong ba la// dran rtsis tsab tsub bya mi dgos// gang shar ngo bo 'char ba la// rnam rtog gi phyi rjes gcod mi dgos// don dam bden pa'i ngo don la// kun rdzob kyi gsal stong blta mi dgos// shar grol dus mnyam du byung ba la// bde sdug gi res 'jog btsir mi dgos// nyin snang mtshan mor shar ba la// rmi lam gyi sprul sgyur byed mi dgos// sems gdod nas phyag rgya chen po la// glo bur gyi bcas bcos byed mi dgos// don rig thog nas grub pa'i chos sku la// 'khrul snang gi ngo sprod bya mi dgos// chos bden med 'dzin med kun brtags la// ched 'dzin gyi a 'thas byed mi dgos| |don gang shar gyi phyi rjes mi gcod cing*// de bzo med gcer yan du bskyangs pa na// chos sku sbar bcangs shig de na yod// don de 'dra'i gnas tshul ma mthong na// sgom tsab tsub mang yang kha na med// chos snying por dril ba de ka yin// don de 'dra chos kyi grags pa'i ngag

/pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i gsung 'phrin yin// grogs mos ldan gyi rna bar sgrog rgyu yin// sems sbar 'dzin byed pa'i pho nya yin// don 'di las gzhan med thugs la zhog /khyod mnga' ris rgyal sras dgyes par mdzod// gnas bye ri stag rtse'i pho brang gi// khyams khams gsum re'u mig nas bris/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rtogs ldan zung 'jug rdo rje la gdams pa/ rtogs ldan dur khrod pa zung 'jug rdo rje'i nyams myong gi 'bul ba mchog tu bzang*/ gang yang 'di yin med pa'i gsal stong ngar bcas 'di nyid sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba la nyams kyis cung zad bteg pa yin/ nyams la snang nyams dang shes nyams gnyis 'byung ba'i snang nyams yun ring du mi sdod yal nas 'gro/ shes nyams bzo med gang shar gyi ngo bo 'dzin med du bskyangs pas rtogs pa drod thob par tshegs med/ gsal stong gi nyams de ka lha dang bla mar 'char ba sems nyid 'od gsal las sgyu ma lta bu'i skur ldang ba yin/ zhag bco lnga tsam gnyid med pa ni khams 'dus pa yin/ gnyid kyi thim rim ngos zin nas rmi lam gyi 'go 'char zhing*/ rmi lam gnyid 'thug gi dge sbyor dang 'dra ba de dge sbyor la 'bad pa thon pa'i rtags su 'dug pas de mus su bskyang na dge sbyor nyin mtshan 'dre ba myur du 'byung*/ 'on kyang dge sbyor nyin mtshan tshad ldan 'dres kyang gnyid 'thug gi brgyal thabs 'od gsal du ma grol bas 'phrang cung zad yong ba mang bas re zhig 'od gsal 'dzin pa la 'bad pa bton na 'phral bogs che/ gtum mo'i yon tan gyi rtsa ba gnyis yod pas/ gnas skabs su drod kyi rtags thon na gos kyi 'khri ba chod pa tsam yin yang*/ mthar thug gi yon tan skye ba'i myu gu skyon med bde ba 'ba' zhig yin pas/ chags pa'i yul mthong ngam thos pa tsam gyis bde ba skye zhing khams 'pho ba tsam gyi bde ba shugs che ba shin tu legs/ bde ba skyes tsam nyid nas mi 'gog cing*/

sna mi bskyil bar bde ba'i rang bzhin stong pa/ stong pa'i rang mdangs bde ba/ de gnyis me dang du ba ltar lhan skyes 'bral med yin pas bde stong zung 'jug tu skyong*/ khams 'chor du nye nas ka med byung na ma gtogs skad cig de ma thag 'dren 'grems ma byas par bde ba shugs che zhing yun ring ba'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med brjod 'das la mnyam par bzhag /bde ba yal ba'i tshe bde ba skye ba la mthong thos dran reg gang shugs che ba des bde ba bskul nas sngar ltar bsgom/ 'pho bar nye na 'dren 'grems kyang bya/ 'pho ba tsam gyi nyen med na 'dren 'grems mgyogs na bde ba yun thung bas de ltar mi bya/ sngags bla med kyi nyams len gyi rtsa ba gcig bde stong zung 'jug yin pas lam 'di myur zhing zab pa yin pas 'bad 'bung 'di la 'don pa gal che che/ bde stong zung 'jug la nyams len goms na phyag chen rang shugs kyis grub zin pa yin/ phyag chen la nyams len goms kyang bde stong la kha ma reg na cung zad lam skor thag ring zhing bul pas gnad 'di go ba gal che che/ rang lus gzhan lus kyi gnad la ma brten par chags yul mthong thos dran tsam gyis bde ba 'bar ba sngags lam la 'bad na yon tan skye ba'i rigs can yin 'dug pas skal pa mchog tu bzang ba'i rigs can zhig yin 'dug go// da lam de tsam gyis chog par 'dug pas kha thag ring po ma bris/ slar gegs sel bogs 'don gang dgos mu can du byed pa yin/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rtogs ldan nam mkha' dbang phyug la gdams pa/ rtogs ldan nam mkha' dbang phyug gis rtogs pa'i 'bul ba byas par rjes su yi rang*/ de dag la yin lugs so sor brjod na/ thog mar phyi'i snang ba thams cad ding ding 'ur 'ur smug zhag gis khengs pa lta bu de rlung sems 'dus pa'i rtags yin/ nyams len rim lnga yin na 'di la ngo sprod cig yod kyang phyag chen la ma byas/ nang nas rtsis 'dzin mkhan phra mo yod pa ni don 'gyu ba las ma 'das/

de'i rjes gsal cha che ba'i ngang nas 'char sgo gsal stong ngo shes pa gsal stong rang chas ngar dang bcas pa bskyed rim gsal ba 'char sgo rang dag ni don du gsal stong gi nyams shas che ba yin/ de'i skabs gnyid mtshams 'gyu ba ngos zin na dge sbyor du 'gro/ ma zin na brgyal thabs la 'gro ba de nyams kyi 'od gsal yin/ skabs der chos drug gi gnad ston mi zhig yod na/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal skad cig la shar nas gnyid 'thug 'od gsal du dag pa zhig yong rgyu yin yang*/ chos drug gi gdams pas ma zin pas cung zad len/ de'i rjes bskyed rim dang 'char sgo sogs mi gsal ba ra ro ba lta bu la rtogs pa'i nga rgyal yong ba de sngar gi nyams rnam dag 'od gsal ma zin par nyams dag pa'i shul du khams 'dus shing stong nyid shugs drag pas thal byung lta bu yin/ de'i skabs mtshan mo mar me yod pa lta bu gsal stong lhang nge ba ni nyams kyi 'od gsal srab mo zin par 'dug /de la gnad du bsnun na rtogs pa'i 'od gsal du 'gro ba yin/ de'i rjes re dogs rtog dpyod rtsis 'dzin gang yang med pa de sems kyi ngo bo mthong du nye ba tsam yin/ de'i rjes snang stong gnyis ka la the tshom za ba gsal stong so sor dbye ba 'byed du mi btub pa de ka sems kyi ngo bo yin/ de'i rjes dran pa 'char sgo la phar song zer ba de en tsam ngag nas ma thon pa 'dra/ don du gsal stong tha mi dad pa la/ 'di yin rtsis gdab med pa/ 'gyu dran snang ba thams cad go mi 'gag cing der 'dzin med pa/ stong had min pa/ gsal 'dzin med pa de ka phyag rgya chen po yin/ yang dran pa 'char sgo la phar song ba dang*/ 'char sgo dran pa la tshur thim pa 'dra ba de mtshan 'dzin gyi don du 'char sgo dang dran pa me dang du ba ltar gcig med na gcig mi 'byung ba yin pas snang sems tha dad med cing 'gyu dran ngo bo gcig pa de ka yin/ lus lha dang spyi bor bla ma bsgoms kyang gsal rgyu med pa dang*/

sgom yul mi skye ba sogs da dung stong nyams shas che ba yin/ gnyid 'thug mi zin pa ni 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i thabs la gnad du ma bsnun pa'i skyon tsam yin/ gnyid du nyin mo dang khyad med par dge sbyor du 'gro/ de nyin mtshan snang ba 'dre ba'i snga ltas yin pas legs/ de'ang thugs dam la 'bad 'bung 'don pa dang*/ lhag par khyed kyi dge sbyor 'di la 'gyur ldog shin tu che ba'i rigs can zhig yin 'dug pas/ dus kun tu rtog pa sgro btags dang bral ba/ snang sems der 'dzin dang bral ba/ 'gyu dran blos byas dang bral ba/ gzung 'dzin blang dor dang bral ba/ gsal stong rnam dbye dang bral ba/ chos thams cad zung 'jug mnyam nyid dper na dngos po'i rdzas grub to cog mer bsreg na me nyid las dngos po gzhan du mi snang zhing*/ dngos po de dag thams cad me 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gro ba/ dngos po de rnams las me so sor dbye ba med par me lce gcig tu 'bar ba ji lta bar/ rnam rtog 'gyu dran tshor drug snang sems sogs 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad spang blang re dogs bsal bzhag med pa/ gang ltar snang bar gang shar ba/ gang mthong thos snom myong reg pa thams cad der 'dzin 'gag sgrub spang blang bcos lhad med pa/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong 'dzin med/ mtha' bral khyab gdal 'byams klas pa'i klong las gzhan du mi spro/ mi bsdu/ mi rtog /mi sems/ mi dmigs par/ ngo bo ka dag /rnam pa gsal stong*/ gzhi rtsa mtha' bral gyi gnas lugs bzo bcos med par 'jog pa/ dper na mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar sprin sogs ji ltar snang yang*/ nam mkha' la blo bzo rtog btags med pa ltar/ 'dzin med yeng med bzo med kyi ngang du 'jog /rnam rtog skyes pa tshor drug gi snang ba sogs gang ltar shar/ gang ltar snang*/ gang ltar mthong thos sems kyang de'i phyi mi bsnyeg /sna mi bskyil/ bcos lhad med par de ka'i ngo bo gcer yan du skyong ba ma gtogs/

de la slar gnyen po rgyag pa sogs rnam rtog la rnam rtog gi rtseg pa ma brtsegs pa/ grang ba'i nad la ga pur byin pa ltar sman dug tu song ba ma yin pa zhig spyir bka' brgyud rin po che/ sgos mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi nying khu yin pas/ sems kyi gting du 'jog pa gal che ba yod do yod do yod do/ khyod kyi dge sbyor 'di 'gyur ldog shin tu che ba zhig 'dug pas/ rtsal chen po yong ba'i rigs can la shor gol la shin tu gzab dgos pas/ da dung 'gyur ldog mi bde ba byung na slar yi ger bris nas byung na/ gegs sel bogs 'don gang dgos cis kyang byed pas de lugs kyang mdzod/ ces rtogs ldan nam mkha' dbang phyug gi dge sbyor gyi 'dri ba'i lan du/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa'am dbur smyon padmas btags pas/ sa yos sa ga can gyi tshes gsum la gsang ba sngags kyi gan mdzod chen por mgyogs par bris so/// / ༈ /a ce nor 'dzoms la gdams pa/ a ce nor 'dzoms kyi mnyam bzhag snga sor khrid zhus 'phral du kha 'don byang chub pa rnams dang las ka sla ba rnams dge sbyor dang mnyam du 'khobs la/ gzhan mi 'khobs pa de ni khrid bskyangs 'phral du gnas pa la ma goms pa yin/ de'i rjes dran pas sleb tshe thams cad 'khobs shing gsal cha che zhing dran shed che ba snying gi thad nas hur re yod pa 'dra ba de ni spyir dran pa shed che zhing gsal cha che ba de ni gsal nyams yin la/ snying gi thad na yod snyam pa ni rang gi nyams snang tsam yin pa ma gtogs snying gi thad na dran pa med pa gzhir bcas/ de rjes snying gi thad nas hur re ba med pa de ni nyams snang de ka med par song ba yin la/ dran pa shed che chung skyon che chung gi stabs su 'gro ba ni dran pa stobs chung bas rkyen drag po ma thub/ chung ngu thub pa yin/ skyong bde dus bying rgod gang yang med pa rjen lhang nge ba nges shes 'drongs pa/

rnam rtog gang skyes dran pa'i ngo bor 'gro ba/ bla ma la mos gus bcos min skye ba de ni bde ba'i nyams shar ba yin/ skyong mi bde ba 'dra ba'i rnam rtog mang ba ni gnas pa dang po'i skabs yin pas/ rnam rtog ri gzar gyi rbab dang 'dra zhes bshad/ res 'ga' mgo la thang khug g.yogs pa 'dra ba phyi'i rdig khrog ge ba la/ de rjes dran pa mi 'brang ba ni gnas cha yin pas/ gnas pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa dang mar me rlung gis mi skyod pa lta bu zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ mnyam bzhag byas ma byas la ma ltos par skyong bde mi bde nges med du 'ong ba ni da dung dge sbyor la cung zad brtan pa ma thob pa'i rtags yin/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams dang gnas pa'i cha 'di rnams yun ring thung dang rdos drag mi drag tsam ma gtogs thams cad rim gyis dag dgos pas gang byung yang ma ltos/ bzang la mi re/ ngan par dogs mi dgos/ de rjes zhe sdang la sogs pa nyon mongs kyi rtog pa gang rung zhig skyes tshe dran pas slebs pa la dran pa de'ang bcos mi dgos par nyon mongs dang*/ dran pa ngo bo gcig pa de'i ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug rjen gsal du 'dug pa de ka sems kyi ngo bo yin/ nyon mongs dang dran pa gnyis ka mnyam du sdod pa mi srid/ nyi ma dang mun pa mnyam du mi 'ong ba dang 'dra na'ang*/ da lta dge sbyor stobs chung nyon mongs dang dran pa mnyam du sdod pa 'dra zhig 'byung ba yin/ da dung 'bad nas bsgoms pas nyon mongs shas chung du 'gro ba dang dran pa stobs che ru 'gro ba dus mnyam du 'ong*/ lar nyon mongs skyes tshe bcos mi dran pa la dgos pa med pas/ nyon mongs de ka'i ngo bo dang dran pa tha mi dad gcig dgos pa yin/ dge sbyor la brtan pa thob na rmi lam 'od gsal ched du sgom mi dgos kyang*/ dge sbyor la rang dbang ma thob na bar dor mi 'khrul ba'i ched du rmi lam yang 'dzin sgyur sprul sbyong byed pa gal che/

'od gsal yang brtan pa med par bsdad pas gnyid la song ba yin la/ brgyal thabs dang rmi lam med par nyin mo dge sbyor gyi ngo bo bskyangs pa ltar sems la der 'dzin med par yun ring thung gang yin yang sdod pa la/ slar gnyid sad rgyu yod pa de ka 'od gsal zin pa yin pas de la 'bad rtsol gyis sgom pa gal shin tu che/ 'di nyid la goms 'dris brtan pa thob na shi ma thag tu grol bar the tshom med pa yin/ da phyin nyin mo rnam rtog gang shar mi dgag cing de la ched 'dzin mi byed par gang shar de ka bzo med du bskyangs pas shar grol dus gcig tu 'byung ba de ka 'bad de sgoms/ rnam rtog ma skyes na ma skyes pa ltar sgoms/ skyes na skyes pa la ched 'dzin med par sgoms/ nub mo snga ma lta bu'i 'od gsal de ka la 'bad nas bsgoms pas bogs thon pa yong*/ 'od gsal de ka'i ngang nas dran pa gsal ba/ mnyam bzhag brtan pa/ rmi lam rmi rgyu med pa/ brgyal thabs nag thom yang min pa/ de byung na thams cad las de ka dga' bas de la 'bad 'bung 'don dgos pa yin pas de ltar thugs la 'jog pa gal che zhu/// /maṅga laṃ// swa sti pra dze bhyaḥ ༈ /yang 'od gsal rang gang la ngos 'dzin zhus pas/ 'od gsal gyi mtshan nyid rang gis gnyid kyi ngo bo shes ma shes gang yin rung*/ gnyid la song ba gnyid 'thug gi brgyal thabs med pa/ rmi lam gyi 'khrul snang med pa/ sems nyin mo'i mnyam bzhag byed dus dang 'dra 'dra ba la/ de las kyang gsal zhing dwangs pa mi g.yo ba rjen gsal 'dzin med gsal stong zung du 'jug pa la gnas shing*/ de las ldang ba'i tshe gnyid sad rgyu yod pa zhig byung na snang med kyi 'od gsal mtshan nyid pa yin/ de la goms na shi ma thag shi ba'i brgyal thabs kyang med cing*/ bar do'i 'khrul snang yang mi 'byung bar/ da lta sgom pa'i gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal 'di nyid/ 'chi ba'i tshe brgyal thabs 'od gsal du shar ba ngo 'phrod nas grol ba la tshe 'dir grol ba zhes rgyal ba gong ma rnams bzhed pa yin/

da dung 'dri rtog gang dgos mu can mdzod/// / ༈ /a ce nor 'dzoms kyi thugs dam rtogs pa 'khrungs lugs de la lam rnam dag ma gtogs gol shor lam log tu song ba spu tsam mi 'dug kyang*/ rnam rtog skyes tshe de kha gsal stong du song rjes blo yul tsam ma bde ba de rjes shes la byang ma chub pa yin pas/ da dung sngar mus ltar 'bad pas mthar mnyam rjes 'dres pa zhig 'byung*/ res 'ga' rnam rtog phra rags thams cad gsal stong du 'gro zhing*/ res 'ga' rnam rtog tsab tsub gsal stong du mi 'gro ba'ang skyon med/ rnam rtog gsal stong du song bas dga' rgyu med/ ma song bas sdug rgyu med/ rnam rtog de ka gsal stong yin pas/ bde sdug sogs gang shar blos byas kyi bcos lhad ma byas par rnam rtog de ka ma bkag /ma sgrub/ de rjes mi 'brang bar de ka bcos med 'dzin med gcer yan du bskyangs pas chog pa yin/ nyams len gyi rtsa ba bzang rtog ngan rtog gang skyes kyang 'dra/ ma skyes kyang 'dra/ dus rgyun du ma yeng ba tsam pa'i ngang nas rang ngo rang gis bltas pas bcos med gang shar 'dzin med du skyong ba nyid gal che/ gzhan pa res 'ga' skyong bde ba dang*/ res 'ga' skyong mi bde ba lta bu 'phral 'phral rnam 'gyur mang po 'byung ste/ de 'dra gang byung yang skyon med/ chu bo chen po rnams dbyar dus rgyas shing dgun dus chab rom du snang yang*/ ngo bo chu nyid las ma 'das pa dang khyad med/ dus thams cad du byams snying rje/ dad pa dang dag snang*/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig srung mtshams las ma 'das pa dang*/ nyams len thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis rtsis zin pa zhig phyag rgya chen po'i lam gyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don du gal che ba yin no/// / ༈ /dpon sa'i drung la gdams pa/ bying nas dpon sa'i drung nas zhal gdams shig dgos gsungs par/ phyag rgya chen po'i gegs sel bogs 'don rgyal ba gong ma'i gsung dang*/

kho bo'i rtog med rdo rje'i glu la sogs par gsal zhing*/ zhib pa ni rang rang gi rtogs pa skye lugs dang 'tsham pa'i skabs su gang bab ma gtogs/ da lta 'di kho na zer ba bcad thang ma cang med| don gyi snying po da lta mi lus thob pa don med du ma song ba zhig byed dgos la/ khyad par nges don gyi lam bsgom pa/ bskyed rim dang sngags bzla ba/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba la brtson pa lhur len pa/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba/ phar phyin drug la ci nus su 'bad pa/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba slob dpon gyi dam tshig srog la bab kyang bsrung ba/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa mgo gang mtho nas chos kyi gnyen pos gnon cing*/ rang gis rang la zhe mi khrel ba'i dge sgrub sdig spong rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa'i spang blang byed pa shin tu gal che ba yin no/// / ༈ /she'u rdzi'i rtogs ldan la gdams pa/ she'u rdzi'i rtogs ldan da lta mtshams bcad dam zhing thugs dam 'phel bar yod 'dug pa legs/ deng sang 'dzin thag chad nas blos byas kyi spros pa thams cad dang bral nas/ ngo bo dang rnam pa'i dbye ba mi 'dug /'dra zhig 'dra na gnas pa 'ba' zhig yug cig la 'byams 'gro ba/ skyong tshod res 'jog thams cad bral nas snying rus kyang byed dang mi byed cig mi snang*/ brlag pa yin nam/ kha seng gi gnas tshul e go zer mkhan 'dra zhig byas nas sdod mi nyan/ gol sar shor ba e yin bsam pa sogs 'gyur ldog che ba byung 'dug kyang*/ de dag thams cad nyams rtags kho na yin la/ don la 'gyur ldog med kyang*/ rnam par 'gyur ldog byed pa la 'bad pas sgom pa gal che/ snga sor lab ltar bsgom rgyu 'dug na 'dug pa de ga sgoms/ bsgom rgyu mi 'dug na mi 'dug pa de ga sgoms/ gang ltar 'dug pa de ga la bzo med bcos med du sgoms/ rjes snyeg mi dgos/ dgag mi dgos/

sgrub mi dgos/ re ba dang dogs pa mi dgos/ gol sa e yin snyam pa'ang rnam rtog yin/ 'dzin stangs mi 'dug snyam pa'ang rnam rtog yin pas/ re zhig bzang ngan re dogs 'dzin blo thams cad med par gang shar 'dzin med kyi ngang du kha rog zhog la sgoms dang*/ da dung 'gyur ldog mang du 'byung*/ thad so gcig la sdod mi yong*/ gang zag lam zhugs la rtogs pa legs legs 'dra yang legs rgyu med/ nyes nyes 'dra yang nyes rgyu med/ dper na zhing sa'i ljang pa legs legs 'dra yang sad ser gyis 'khyer ba mang*/ nyes nyes 'dra'ang 'char zhod bdag rkyen thogs na ston 'bras bu legs pa 'ong srid pas re zhig 'bad pas sgom pa gal che/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris pa gnyis la gdams pa/ grogs mnga' ris gnyis kyis dris pa'i lan// sems rnam mi rtog la rnam rtog btags// don skye med la 'khrul ba'i sems byung skyes// gshis brjod med la brjod rgyu sna tshogs byung*// 'di rtog btags kyi 'khrul blo'i sgom chen pa// stong lta had pos rgyal khams gang*// rtag chad lta ba dus gcig 'dzoms// mi nga la nyams rtogs slar ma skyes// sngon grangs med dus kyi rang gshis 'di// bzang ngan gyi 'gyur ldog cang mi gda'// sems shel dkar dri med gong bu 'di// gshis ci yang ma grub dwangs sang nge*// der kha dog sna tshogs rgyu rkyen gyis// grogs bzang ngan kun dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// mdangs 'gag med sna tshogs 'char bar gda'// rkyen de dang bral tshe sems de la// kha dog 'gyur ldog gi nyen mi gda'// shel kha dog gi dbang du phar ma song*// tshon shel dkar gyi gshis la tshur ma 'dres// don 'di las bsgom rgyu cang ma rnyed// sems rnam rtog der snang ngo bos stong*// rnam rtog lhan po rgyag mi dgos// sems gdod nas rang gshis 'od gsal ba// gnyid 'thug gi gti mug ming dang bral// 'chi dus kyi 'od gsal rtsir gyis zin// sems chos skur rtogs tshe las kyi rlung*// skyon med rang gshis kyi longs skur shar// 'di 'bad nas bdag gis btsal ba min// sems rlung dang tha dad med pa yin// nyin mtshan gyi 'khrul blo rtsad ma bcad// 'khrul ba dang sems nyid dbyer ma mchis| |sems spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// 'khrul bya 'khrul byed btsal mi dgos// 'khrul ba la 'khrul ba'i nyams len pa// sgom chen phal gyi pha 'bab mdzod// don 'di las bdag gi nyams len med// 'khor 'das kyi re dogs byed mi dgos// sems nam mkha' ji bzhin zhig tu med// lus kun rdzob bden pa ngo bos stong*// skye 'chi la sogs rtog btags tsam| |tshe sgrub sogs sdug dogs bya mi dgos// gang byung lam du ma lhong na// bka' brgyud yongs kyi rkang 'dren yin// de phyir 'di don mkhyen par mdzod// ces mnga' ris pa gnyis kyi dogs gcod byas pa'i lan du 'bri gung pa dbur smyon zhes chos kyi grags pas/

rang sems kyi sdod lugs bcos lhad med par bris pa yin no/// / ༈ /lha rtse'i dpon sa la gdams pa/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang de yi sras// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas// bden pa'i stobs kyis skal ldan rnams// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas byang chub tu// mngon sangs rgyas pa'i smon lam 'debs// de lhag bsam dag pa'i mtshams sbyar nas| |gegs med du 'grub pa chos nyid yin// rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar// rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis kyang*// gcig nas gcig tu gsungs pa yi// zhal gdams snying po 'di nyid yin| |khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'di ru// da len mi lus thob dus 'dir// don med stong log tu ma song ba'i// sgom sgrub byed pa gdams pa'i gtso// rtsod dus bskal pa'i mar zhabs 'dir// tshe lo bzhi bcu kha ral la// yun ring sgrub pa'i long med pas// zab mo sngags kyi theg pa'i chos// rten 'brel zab mo'i chos nyid can// pho nya'i lam bzang bsten par rigs// srod la srog rtsol gtum mo sgoms// dga' ba bzhi la rtsal sbyangs nas// zung 'jug bde stong lhan skyes dngos// yan lag bdun ldan sgrub 'tshal lo// gung la rmi lam 'khrul ba'i blo// phyag rgya chen po dang bsres nas// sprul sgyur gnad kyi gdams pa yis// 'khrul ba chos skur rtogs 'tshal lo// tho rangs gnyid 'thug gti mug nyams// 'od gsal stong bzhi'i gnad bsnun pas// skye med rang ngo rang gis shes// gti mug chos skur rtogs 'tshal lo// nyin mo 'khrul snang sgyu mar sbyongs// dag dang ma dag zhen rtog bral// snang srid sgyu ma'i rol par shar// rtog snang longs skur sgrub 'tshal lo// lam gyi nyen can bar do ru// bla ma'i gdams ngag dran pa'i blos// 'khrul snang sku gsum lam blangs nas// 'khor bar mi 'khor 'bad 'tshal lo// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po dang*// rang rig ye shes gyes pa'i tshe// 'da' ka 'pho ba'i gdams pa yis// rang rtsal go 'phang sgrub 'tshal lo// snang srid 'khrul ngor grub pa'i blo// rtog snang sna tshogs rig pa'i rtsal// gang byung bzo bcos bral ba'i gnad// ma bcos sgom gyi snying po yis// snang srid phyag rgya chen por grol// don gnyis bsgrub la 'bad 'tshal lo// snying gtam gnad kyi yi ge 'di// pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i bzhed srol yin// skal ldan rnams kyi nyams len yin// byang chub sgrub pa'i gsang tshig yin| |dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog

/ces pa'ang lha rtse nas dpon sa'i bkas smon lam zhal gdams shig dgos gsungs par rang gi zhe 'dod kyi smon lam dang*/ nyams len rang rgyud la yod pa rnams mdor bsdus nas*/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bye ri stag rtser bris pa'o/// / ༈ /phru gu 'grang bu la gdams pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma mchog /gnas spyi gtsug rgyan du mdzes par bsten// chos phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// sems gdod ma'i gshis babs kho na'i ming*// don de dag nyams su blang ba'i thabs// skyabs thub pas 'khor lo gsum du bshad// tshul de yi nyams len mdor bsdus pa// lar rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyis bkral// don phyin ci ma log gnad dril ba// pha 'jig rten mgon po'i bzhed pa ltar// gnad 'gag don dril ba kho bos bri// sems rnam rtog lhan skyes dri ma de// rang ngo bos stong zhes brjod pa'i don// gzhi de la de nyid mi ldan par// don ngo bo mthong tshe de bral ba// ming rang stong tsam du tha snyad mdzad// khams rang bzhin rnam dag 'gyur med de// gnas ji ltar byas kyang gdod nas grub// tshul de nyid rang ngos ma stong bar// dbyings bsal bzhag med par rtag brtan pa// chos gzhan stong zhes pa tha snyad tsam// de lugs lta ba thag bcad nas// sgom nyams len lag tu 'di ltar blang*// sems 'gyu dran bcad nas sgom pa'i tshe// tshul gar yang mi 'phro rang sar gnas// tshogs yul snang drug po chu zla ltar// lar brag cha ji bzhin tshor snang yang*// de don byed med par cham me ba// don de la zhi gnas tsam du btags// sems rnam rtog gzugs dang kha dog bral// ming btags pa tsam las gtad so med// rkyen gang ltar byas kyang bsgyur ba la// de 'ja' tshon ji bzhin snang la stong*// sems ngo bo ma skyes 'gag gnas bral// lar gang shar gang snang de dag kun// dpe byis pas lha khang mthong ba 'dra// 'di lhag mthong nyi tshe ba ru 'dod// sems ngo bo smra bsam shes brjod bral// rgya gar yang ma chad phyogs ma lhung*// don mnyam bzhag klong 'byams g.yo med ngang*// 'gyu dran rnams ma 'gag so sor shar// der snang der 'dzin med pa ru// dpe sbrul mdud ji bzhin grol ba la// ming zhi lhag zung du 'brel bar btags// sems rang ngo rang gis tur gyis mthong*// de mthong ngo snyam du bltas pa'i tshe// blta bya dang lta byed gtad so bral// de med snyam bzhag na gsal rig ngar// don rjen gsal hrig por mthong ba la// sems ngo mthong zhes pa'i tha snyad byas// de rnam rtog la spang dgag 'dzin sgrub kyi// bcos lhad rtog btags ma byas par// gang shar gyi ngo bo 'dzin med du// dus rgyun chad med par yeng med sgoms| |dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// sgom rgyun chags kyi skyong lugs de kho na// gnad de min gyi zang zing mang na yang*// kha mkhas zhe dred kyi sgom chen pa// tshe 'dir zhen mkhan tsho 'byung nyen 'dug

/yi dam sngags bzlas rlung 'khrul 'khor// mkhas btsun dang 'gro 'dug la sogs pa// mchog dman gyi bya spyod gang la'ang*// gnad nyams len de dang ma bral na// bslu med rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel las// 'phral snang du skyid sdug ci 'dra yang*// don sangs rgyas las gol ba'i ngan song du// 'gro mi dgos thag chod blo bde'i dpal// dus kun tu bla mar mos gus dang*// tshul khrims kyi srung sdom sems can la// pha mar shes nges byams snying rje// dam chos kun gzhan du sems bskyed bya// lus tha mal du ma lus lha ru gsal// ngag tha mal du ma lus sngags bzlas dang*// dge rtsa kun gzhan don rdzogs byang bsngo// yab 'jig rten mgon po dngos mjal yang*// tshig gsung tshul gyi spros pa ma gtogs pa// don 'di las bstan bya gzhan 'dug na// mi kho bos rgyu 'bras bslus pa yin// don de skad phru gu 'grang bu pa// gnas tsā rir 'gro bar dgos zer ba// bdag shākya'i dge slong gyi na ba// sngags rdo rje theg la longs spyod cing*// don 'khor 'das bzang ngan med pa ru// rang sems su rtogs pa'i 'bri gung pa// ming chos kyi grags pa zhes bya bas// gnas rtse bar bris so dge bar shog// / ༈ /a ce nor 'dzoms la gdams pa/ a ce nor 'dzoms kyis dris pa'i lan du/ dge sbyor gyi rtsa ba rang sems las gzhan du med phyin/ gnas skabs cung zad skyong bde ba dang mi bde ba la mi ltos/ rnam rtog kyang yod med la mi ltos/ don du sems las logs su gyur pa med phyin rnam rtog byung bar ngan rgyu dang ma byung bar bzang rgyu med/ rnam rtog byung yang der 'dzin med cing*/ de la dga' sdug gang yang med par ma bcos bzo med du skyong ba las gzhan med/ rtog pa bzang ngan gang skyes kyang der 'dzin med pa/ de nyid bkag pa ma yin/ spangs pa ma yin/ rjes su 'brangs pa ma yin par de ga'i sems ngo bo las ma g.yos par bskyangs pas rnam rtog yal ba ma yin/

rnam rtog sems su song ba ma yin pa/ rang spangs su song ba lta bu sems kyi ngo bo las ma g.yos pa de gas chog /dran pa dang rnam rtog sems gsum dbyer med gcig po de ga yin/ snying rje dang mos gus sogs bcos min du byung na de ga rang yin/ ma byung na bcos nas bskyed pa gal che/ de rnams lam du song ba yin/ gnyid du song dus tshor drug 'gag pa'i sems gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu der 'dzin med pa de gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal rang yin/ tshor drug tshor bzhin par der 'dzin med par byung na srab mo'i 'od gsal yin pas de gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal du 'gyur dgos/ nyi zla shar ba lta bu sogs 'od gsal rjes mthun pa yin pas slar sgom pa gal che/ slar 'gyur ldog dang 'dri rtsad dgos pa byung na lan gsal mdzod/// / ༈ /dpon sa'i drung par gdams pa/ bying nas dpon sa'i drung pa'i thugs dam skyong tshul de bzhin la/ bde dogs dang re dogs mang bar byung 'dug pas/ snga sor zhus pa ltar/ phyag chen rang sa chig chod du skyong ba la/ bskyed rim sems bskyed sogs dge ba'i rnam rtog dang*/ nyon mongs kyi rtog pa gnyis ka la don rnam rtog yin par gcig dgos pas bzang po la re zhing dang du mi blang*/ ngan pa la dogs shing dgrar 'dzin mi spang*| bzang ngan gang shar 'dzin med bcos lhad med par rang so thad babs su skyongs/ skyong tshul bde ba dang mi bde ba'ang gnas skabs su de ltar snang ba ni 'khrul ngor ma gtogs don la sems nyid la bde ba dang mi bde ba'i tha snyad med phyin skyong tshul de 'dra ci la yod/ re zhig gang shar de ga la dgag pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ re dogs dang*/ blang dor gang yang mi dgos/ rnam rtog la slar bzo bcos kyang mi dgos/ gang shar gang 'dug de ga rang babs kyis skyongs/ sems ma brjed tsam thun chung grang mang bar mdzad pa zhu/// / ༈ /bo dong bka' bcu dkon mchog bstan 'dzin la gdams pa/

thog med bgrang yas dus nas da lta'i bar// rigs drug gnas su zo chun ltar 'khor yang*// dam chos tshul bzhin ma spyad de 'bras kyis// da dung 'khor bar 'khyams 'di yi re mug /da res dal 'byor skyon med 'di thob pa// rnyed dka' 'jig sla myur du 'chi 'gyur zhing*// las kyi dbang gis gar skye cha med pas// mi lus chud ma zos pa chos la gzhol// dam chos byed blor nam 'chi cha med pa// myur du bya ran phyi bshol mi bya ba// kha 'phrad sna 'phrad dge ba'i las la bkol// dam chos rang gar spyad kyang tshul mthun dka'// de bas brtags byas bla ma mtshan ldan bsten// mnyes pa rab sgrub zhal gyi gdams ngag blang*// thub bstan sgor zhugs bslab gsum srog ltar 'dzin// nyams len chos la bzang ngan 'dzin stangs med// grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin rang rgyud brlag pa'i rgyu// bstan don yin sems phyogs lhung rtsod pa 'dis// 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rtsa bar thag bcad nas// rang nyid gang mos sngon gyi las smon yin// lam der zhugs nas gnyis med nyams su blang*// thos pa rgya chen thal phyir tha snyad dang*// rig lam bcu phrag mkhas 'dod rgya bskyed dang*// tshul 'chos kha mkhas btsun btsun la sogs pa// de kun snang shas ltar snang dam chos yin// rang sems chos sku gdod ma'i gshis rtogs pa'i// thabs ni nyams rtogs ldan pa'i bla ma yi// myong khrid gdeng ldan de la rag las kyi// de min gnas lugs ji bzhin rang sems don// phra phyir thos dang don dam phyir bsam pas// zab phyir 'jig rten sgom gyis mi rtogs pa// ma pham pas gsungs 'di nyid snying la brnag /de phyir myur du sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod na// rbad kham can gyi 'ur gog chos rnams las// lam thag nye ba'i rang gshis rang babs su// bzo med gnyug ma'i don sgom lam la gzhol// 'di la dpe ltas gshar sbyang rtsod ngar dang*// rnga rngung dril 'khrol 'khrul 'khor dka' thub sogs// sgo gsum brel zhing yo byad mi 'dzom dang*// ma byung mi chog dka' las cang ma 'tshal// dben par 'dug nas ma shi ma ltog dang*// ma 'khyag tsam gyi bza' btung gos bsten nas// dal bar sdod cing dal bar bsgoms pa yis// bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub go 'phang de// tshe 'dir sgrub pa'i chos 'di nga re spro// nga la bden par 'dzin pa'i mi yod na// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i chos kyi zhal gdams ni// khog pa dral yang bden gtam 'di las med// de skad smras pas grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i// stangs gcod mdzad rnams khro zhing bkyon na yang*// don la gang gnas rgyal ba rnams kyis dgongs// bden rdzun dpang po gshin rje chos rgyal bzang*// de skad mi smra kha med bo dong pa'i// bka' bcu 'dzin pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin zhes// dge bshes dad pa can gyis nan bskul phyir// ji ltar so 'cha' zos na ma 'dod kyang*// ngan skyug 'dor bzhin dbang med dad pa'i ngor// chos kyi grags pas bris kyi dge gyur cig// /
