༈ /sgrub pa ma ngag dbang yid 'dzin la gdams pa/ sgrub pa ma ngag dbang yid 'dzin gyis rtogs pa'i 'bul ba byas par cis kyang rjes su yi rang*/ dang po khrid ma zhus gong nas lus yod du mi tshor zhing sems stong gsal du gnas pa sogs ni skye ba sngon ma phyag rgya chen po'i lam la bag chags yod pa zhig yin 'dug pas shin tu legs/ gcig pur 'dug pa la dga' ba sogs kyang tshe sngon dben par goms pa zhig yin 'dug /khrid zhus nas rang sems gsal stong las bla mar zhu rgyu ma rnyed pa de ka sems ngo shes shing zhu rgyu don dam par de ka las gzhan pa ci la yod/ rig pa rjen la bud cing bzang ngan gyi re dogs med pa bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du thag chod pa sogs dge sbyor rtsal che ba lam phyed thag nye ba zhig yong rigs su 'dug /lus gnad dang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug mnyam bzhag byas ma byas khyad med pa gang shar bde stong du 'dug pa de nyid phyag chen las sngags lam la bag chags dang skal pa yod pa zhig yin 'dug /chos drug zhu tshe ma bde zhing na ba de khams 'dus pa yin/ gtum mo na tsha dang sdug bsngal gyi dus su slebs pa gtum mo'i lam rtags yin/ mig lam du me stag dang mar me sogs snang ba dang*/ snying kha nas du ba mthong ba sogs las rlung 'byung ba bzhi'i khams can dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed la khad kyi du ba sogs rtags bcu 'char ba'i 'go brtsams pa yin pas/ de ga'i mod la gtum mo dang rlung sbyor la gnad du bsnun 'bad 'bung byas na lam thag nye zhing sa chod gzhan las che ba zhig yong rgyu yin/ rmi lam zin pa sogs kyang las rlung dbu ma'i nang mgrin par 'dus pa'i rtags yin/ gzhan pa phyi nang thams cad mthong ba sogs ni mthong nyams kyi rnam par 'dug /bla ma mthong ba tsam gyis mos gus skye zhing mos gus de ka sgom du 'char ba de bzhin las dang skal pa ldan pa zhig yin 'dug

/da cha phyag chen rang sgom yang rim gyis pa las shogs che ba mi 'byung*/ 'on kyang chos drug sogs rtsa rlung gi nyams len la 'bad na myur zhing bogs che ba zhig yong rigs yin 'dug /phyag chen rang la 'bad na da lta'i dge sbyor 'di la 'gyur ldog bag re 'byung*/ bla ma myong ba can la yang yang gtugs na legs par 'ong*/ gang ltar snga ma phan gyi thugs dam byas tshad lam rnal ma go chod du song bas/ da dung de lugs la 'bad pa rem rem/ zhes pa'ang ngag dbang yid 'dzin gyis dgos zer bar/ 'bri gung pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor 'das rang sems su thag chod pa/ re dogs la spang blang mi dgos pa'i rgan po gyi na ba des bris pa yin no/// / ༈ /rtogs ldan phun tshogs dar la gdams pa/ sems la rnam rtog gang shar yang ngo bo sems las gzhan du song zhing grub pa med pa chu dang chu bur ltar yin pas rnam rtog sems su thag bcad/ tshogs drug gi snang cha thams cad kyang sems kyi 'khrul ngor kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum gyis bsdus te snang ba las/ don du phyi rol du snang ba spu tsam med pas snang ba sems su thag bcad/ sems de nyid kyang rang byung rang gsal ma gtogs skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas sems skye med du thag bcad/ skye med de'ang ngo bo chos sku spros bral zab gsal gnyis med don dam bden med re dogs thams cad dang bral bas skye med stong pa nyid chos skur thag bcad/ chos sku de'ang ci med cang med kyi stong had min pa ngo bos stong pa/ rnam pa gsal ba/ mdangs 'gag med/ rtsal lhun grub tu 'byung ba/ chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa mgon po 'bri gung pas gsungs pa ltar sku gsum tha dad min par thag bcad/ rang don 'khor 'das dbyer med re dogs dang bral ba/ gzhan don chu zla'i rol pa bzhin bsam med brjod bral du 'byung bas don gnyis lhun grub 'bad rtsol bya bral ngang grub tu thag bcad/

thag de rnams chod na 'khor 'das spang blang mi dgos pa blo bde ba'i sar phyin pa yin bsams pa bdag rang gi blor shar tshod yin pas gzhan kun gyi thugs la 'thad mi 'thad ji 'dra na'ang thabs mi gda' lags/ zhes pa rtogs ldan phun tshogs dar gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas ci dran gang dran du bris pa a la la hoḥ ༈ /ye shes phun tshogs la gdams pa/ ye shes phun tshogs kyi rtogs pa'i gnas tshul de la nyams len rnam pa kun tu hril gyis dril na/ sems rnam rtog so sor dbye ba 'byed pa'i nyams len mi dgos/ rang sems gsal stong 'dzin med hrig ngar shugs dang ldan pa de ga ma yeng bar cer cer bltas pas 'gyur ldog med pa mthong ba de ga dge sbyor yin/ rnam rtog gang shar snang srid tshogs drug gang 'dug thams cad sems kyis byas pa'ang min/ sems kyang min/ sems las byung ba'ang min/ thams cad sems yin pa'ang min pas de thams cad sems thog tu tshur yang mi bzhag /sems de rnams kyi phyir rjes su'ang mi 'brang*/ snang srid tshogs drug gang ltar snang*/ gang ltar shar yang de ga ma bcos rang babs rang sems kyi ngang du bsgom du re ba de las ma g.yos pa'i bzo bcos dgag sgrub med par ma yeng bar byed pa don gyi bsgom bya yin pa thag bcad pa yin/ snang mched thob gsum de spyir 'chi ba'i dus dang gnyid la 'gro dus 'byung ba sogs go sla la/ sems don gyi skabs sems ngo bo rkyang pa rnam rtog rags pa 'gag pa rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pa'i skabs/ rnam rtog phra ba 'gag pa snang ba mched pa la thim pa'i skabs/ rnam rtog thams cad 'gags nas sems brjod med wal le snang ba mched pa nyer thob la thim pa'i skabs/ rnam rtog med par sems gsal stong mtha' bral tshogs drug gi rtog pa ma 'gags shing der snang gi bzo bcos med pa nyer thob 'od gsal la thim zhing*/ sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal chen po chos sku ye 'byams don dam bden pa dngos yin pa rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos rim lnga'i thon chos su gsungs pa gnad zab pa yin/

'di la goms na gnyid dang 'chi ba'i snang mched thob gsum gyi tha ma 'od gsal 'dzin pa'ang ches sla zhing gnad zab pa yin/// / ༈ /bla ma 'od gsal sding pa gdan sa ba dkon mchog rnam rgyal la gdams pa/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa// pha rdo rje 'chang dbang mi gzugs can// mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i bi da ra| |mi kho bo'i snying dkyil padmar bzhugs// nga dus mthar skyes pa'i bla ma'i ming*// khong bshad sgrub kyi dam pa gzhan ji bzhin// bstan 'dzin dang 'gro don la sogs pas// 'ur gog gi sgra dbyangs ma byas kyang*// tshe 'dir ltos kyi dal 'byor chud ma gson// sems skye 'chi re dogs dang bral bas// mi rtag pa'i yi mug sgom mi dgos// chos thams cad rten 'byung rgyu 'bras kyi// tshul bcos med du rtogs pas sdig ltung bral// don stong nyid rgyu 'bras rtogs pa yis// dkar nag las 'bras spu ris 'byed// yul dang yul can mtha' dag par// 'khrul ngor mthong ba'i sems bskyed la// bcos ma'i smon 'jug 'geb mi dgos// gnas lugs dang tshul khrims gnad gcig pas// a 'thas kyi rtsis 'jog der ma btang*// lha gdod nas grub par thag bcad pas// bskyed rim la gshar sbyang ngas ma byas// rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa rtsol sgrub bral// bgrang phreng la mtheb tshod rtsis su bral// chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings| |de gdod nas yin zhes bsdu rim zhes// mtha' dbus gcig la gcig thim zhing*// sems rang ngo rang gis mthong ba la// rtsol byas kyi sgom sran ci byar zad// rang gshis rang babs kyis skyong ba la// dran 'dzin dang gnyen po nga la med// don rlung sems gnad gcig don rtogs pas// rlung 'dzin gyi rtsa btsir kha na med// lus g.yo 'gul gang byas 'khrul 'khor nyid| |lnga sbyong sogs rtsis grangs brjed de thal// gshis gdod nas phyag rgya chen por grub// dpe klog gi ngo sprod yi re mug

/'khor 'das kun sems su gcig pa la// mtho ris dang ngan song re dogs bral// don yin lugs nang nas shar ba la// lung rig gi dogs gcod der mi dgos// sems chos skur rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'bras bu phyi mar smon mi 'tshal| |don de ltar mthong ba'i nyams len 'di// gzhi 'bras la bzang ngan mi dgos shing*// lam dang spyod pa shugs 'byung la// spang blang ma dgos nga re brod// ces pa'ang bla ma 'od gsal sding pa gdan sa ba dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dbur stod 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong 'khor 'das rang sems su rtogs pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ sa glang zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun la rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa las brtsams pa'i glu bdun tshan du byas pa bzhugs/ kye ma/ thub bstan gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims zhes// rgyal bas yang yang bsngags pa la// dus deng sang nyams len rab byung bdag /spong sems nges 'byung gi gzhi bzung bas// so thar gyi bslab pa gces par bsrungs// de chen po dor ba'i chung ngu la// rtsis chen gyi gces nor ngas ma byas// pham lhag sogs sde lnga'i rnam grangs kyi// don lci rim gong ma yal dor nas// bcas rkyang gi sdug btsir a 'thas po// bram ze ltar bcos pa'i zhi zhi bo// 'jab 'job kyi tshul 'chos ma shes kyang*| |don srung sems rang rgyud la sbyar bas// rnam pa rig min gyi ngo bo dang*// bcas pa'i rang mtshams zin pa dang*// rang bzhin rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len gsum// don dbyer med du go bas nyams su blangs// bcas rang bzhin gcig pa'i gnad ka des// gsung rab la nang 'gal gyi log lta bral// chos spong ma bsags nga re skyid// ces so thar las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/ lar sangs rgyas thob 'dod yod srid na// med du mi rung chos gcig po// byams snying rje ldan pa'i byang sems 'di// mkhar mthon por rtsig pa'i rmang dang 'dra// de nye ring med pa'i byams pa dang*// phyogs ris med pa'i snying rje dang*// kha gdeng mtshungs pa'i smon pa dang*// lag tu len pa'i 'jug sems dang*// mtha' bral don dam byang sems rnams// rang rgyud sbyar nas nyams blangs shing*// bdag gzhan brje sogs mthon po'i ngag

/kha ru smra zhing lag mi lon// chos brgyad kyi byang sdom ya re cha// bdag dman pas bdag gzhan brje'o zhes// kha mkhas mi 'dod phyogs med kyi// 'gro phan gang 'grub byas byas nas// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba kun// 'gro drug gi bran du btang nas kyang*// rang byas kyi rnam dkar de la byin// gzhan rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bdag nyid la// dngos su smin yang bzod dam snyam// don de la sems bskyed kyi snying po byas// go chod dam mi shes rgyu 'bras shes// theg chen gyi khyu ru tshud nas thal// zhes byang sems las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/ chos zab mor grags pa'i rdo rje theg /don bsdus na smin grol gnyis so skad// lar smin lam dbang gi chu bo de// rang nyams len du dril ba'i rim pa gnyis// lus tha mal dang chad lta gzhom pa la// dpe sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku de// gdod nas yongs grub la nges shes skyes// yas rim mas rim gyi gsal 'debs de// rnam rtog gi phreng bar song gi dogs// ngag tha mal dang las rlung sbyang ba'i phyir// rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa gzhom med du// shab shub kyi bzlas pa a re sdug /yid tha mal dang rtag lta spang ba'i phyir// don rang rig rang rdzogs kyi rdzogs rim sgoms// bsdu rim thim rim gyi ngag 'gros de// don dam gyi kha la ma reg dogs// don snang stong dbyer med kyi bskyed rdzogs de// dpe nam mkhar nyi zla shar ba 'dra// skad cig la gsal zhing skad cig la rdzogs// gnyis med zung 'jug 'di nga re brod// kha slob dang ngag 'gros gshar sbyang gi// bskyed rdzogs kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// don 'di las skyel so gzhan yod na// pha rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod rang shes// zhes pa ni sngags spyi las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/ rgyud kun la grags pa'i chos zab mo// dpal nā ro dang ni gu'i chos drug po// 'phral rlung ltar grags kyang rang nyams su// las 'bral med snying phur 'di la btab// lus gdod nas grub pa lha yi sku// rtsa rlung dang thig le de la tshang*// rlung skye 'gag med pa'i gzhom med sgra// thabs bde ba chen po haṃ yig dngos// stong shes rab mkha' dbyings tsaṇḍa lī// de rang babs gshis kyis 'bar zhing 'dzag

/lus 'gul skyod gshis kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad// don stong nyid rnam pa bde ba'i nyams// rtsal drod du 'bar ba snying la brnag /rtsa btsir gyi rlung dang 'phongs bteg dang*// gnya' lag bkug pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// 'bar 'dzag la sems pa'i 'dzag bde dang*// lus tsha ba skyes pa'i me drod dang*// yid chags pa rgyas pa'i bde nyams dang*// sems had por btang ba'i mi rtog pa// ban log la smon pa'i ras dkar dang*// khyi rgan la smon pa'i ga sha dang*// ro bsha' la smon pa'i thod phor sogs// mi nga la med de ci rang drag /lus chos gos gsum gyis g.yogs byas nas// gshis rang gshis rang babs kyi nyams len rnams// thabs rdo rje theg pas gnad du bsnun// don 'di la bzang ngan ci byung yang*// nga 'gyod pa med do gang byung shog |sems gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer med pa'i// don stong nyid 'od gsal bsgoms bsgoms nas// gnyid 'thug dang 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zhes// ming so sor btags pa brjed nas thal// 'khor 'das kun sgyu ma rmi lam du// rtogs pas mtshan 'phrul 'dzin spel dang*// gnyis snang gi sgyu lus rang sor bzhag /skye shi bar do sems su rdzogs| |sems chos skur rtogs pas 'khor zin gyi// bar do dang 'pho ba gang du sbyang*// lar skad cig dran rdzogs su nyams len la// chos lnga drug gi dbye ba byed ma dgos// don gcig tu dril ba'i rang blo bde// zhes chos drug las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/ sems gdod nas spros pas ma gos par// sems dmigs kyi rim pa 'dir ma byas// rlung skye med don dam rtsol bas stong*| |rdor bzlas kyi rim pa ci la bya// 'khor 'das kun rang bzhin ma grub pa// sgyu lus kyi dpe don gang la sbyor// sems rang gshis 'od gsal chos sku nyid// 'od gsal gyi rim pa dgos rgyu chung*// bden gnyis dbyer med zung du 'jug /gzhan zung du 'jug bya 'jug byed bral// chos zab dang mi zab rang la dris// rang rgyud rang grol du ma song na// gzhan zer gyi zab dgus bslu nyen che// don rang sems dpang por bzhag pa 'di// nyams len gyi gtso bor kho thag chod// ces pa rim lnga las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/

rigs khams rnam dag sangs rgyas nyid// de glo bur gyi dri mas ci la nongs// don rang ngo shes na blo bde dpal// dag pa dang ma dag dag ma dag /lus snang dang sems snang sgyu ma sogs// snang gsum gyi bshad bshad kha re skam// gshis rang babs lha skur grub pa la// don gsal 'debs kyi nges shes rten 'brel gnad// de gsal stong bskyed rdzogs kyi go rim las// don so sor ma mchis gcig tu bzlums// rgyud dang lam rgyud 'bras rgyud gsum// rgyud gsum gyi gshar sbyang 'a thang chad// don gzhi gnas kyi rang gshis lam du blangs// lam nyams len gyi rang snang 'bras bur smin// 'bras don gnyis mi 'grub ka med de// gshis rgyu 'bras su nges so nga re dga'// zhes lam 'bras las brtsams pa'i glu'o// yang*/ spros bral gyi don la bltas bltas nas// lta ba rang gzhan stong tshul sogs| |lta med kyi lta ba de bor nas thal// lta ba 'dzin bral du rtogs so nga re brod// nga rang babs bzo med du bsgoms bsgoms nas// rang blo rang byas kyi 'jog sgom dang*// lung rig kha bshad kyi stong sgom bor nas thal// sgom pa yeng med du 'dug go nga re brod// ngas 'dzin med kyi spyod pa spyad spyad nas// kha mkhas dang mdzes chos kyi zhi dul dang*// gzhan sred kyi spyod pa bor de thal// spyod pa blang dor med de nga re brod// ngas 'bras bu phyi dus su ma bzhag pas// gzhi ngan pa de bskyur lam bzang po// de sgom thob kyi 'bras bu bor nas thal// 'bras bu yid smon med pa nga re brod// ces pa lta sgom spyod 'bras las brtsams pa'i glu'o// de ltar glu yi phreng ba// ma byas byas rdzu mkhan po// ma bsgom sgom rdzu mkhan po// ma yin yin rdzu mkhan po// med kyang yod rdzu mkhan po// ci med cang med mkhan po// rang med gzhan bslu mkhan po// gsob gsog rdzun ris mkhan po// gtad med byar med mkhan po// byed med grub med mkhan po// 'bras med don med mkhan po// mkhan po bcu phrag tshang ba// 'bri ban chos kyi grags pa// mched grogs rin brag bla ma// dkon mchog lhun grub ces pas// u tshugs mu tshugs byas nas// mi dgos ka med gsungs par// ci dran gang dran bris so// don la gnas sam mi gnas// gshin rje chos rgyal ma gtogs// gzhan gyis zhal lce mi chod// bslu med rgyu 'bras ma rtogs// kun gyi gzhal bya min no ang*/// /

༈ /'bu gi la gdams pa/ sems gsal dang sogs sngon du byung ba ni phal cher nyams yin la/ skye ba snga mar chos drug sogs la nyams len byas pa zhig yin na nyams kyi 'od gsal yin pa'ang srid/ de la bla ma nyams myong can zhig gis ngo sprad na rtogs pa'i 'od gsal du shar nas/ 'phral sngags la ma brten kyang sngags kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba zhig yin/ da lta sems kyi ngo bo rnam rtog snang ba sogs ci 'dra gang 'dra byung yang don rtsa dril na/ de thams cad la dgag sgrub spang blang bcos lhad med par rang babs de ga'i rang gshis gang 'dug /rang ris de gas rang gshis bskyangs pas/ rang grol 'dzin bral rang ngo rang mthong*/ rang rtogs rang grub tu 'byung ba yin/ rmi lam sogs sngags lam ma gtogs phyag chen gyi skabs rtsis su mi che bas de ltar mdzad par zhu/ zhes pa'ang snang srid chos skur mthong bas snang ba bden med sgyu mar thal ba zog po mgo skor ba chos kyi grags pas bris so ang*/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /drung chos dbyings mtha' bral gyi zhu lan/ don gnas lugs rtogs pa gang khyod kyis// chos nges don snying po dris pa'i lan// tshig nyung ngur gdams pa 'di skad lo// dus snyigs ma'i chos byed kha mkhas po// don snying po dris na 'chal por 'gro// khas btsun por blangs na rtsab hral byed// de de 'dras sa steng gang dus 'dir// mi khyod nyams len go ma log /don de skad thos pas dga' spro 'phel// dus kun tu de la rjes yi rang*// sems ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug dang*// gzhi de las byung ba'i rnam rtog gnyis// ming so sor btags kyang ngo bo gcig /don de la dgag sgrub spang blang dang*// rnam rtog gi gnyen pos ci zhig bya// gang shar de 'dzin med yeng med du// nyams len de snga mkho ltar ma brjed skyongs// mi nga dang khyod gnyis skyong lugs la// 'dod mnyam du byung bas rang sems mtshar// mi la la'i sems dang rnam rtog la// dran pa dang gnyen po yang yang brtsegs// de ji ltar yin yang skyur la zhog

|nyin snang nyams len mtshan mo ru// gra zur ma chag 'byung ba de// sngar bka' brgyud gong ma'i bzhed srol gyi// gnad nyin mtshan snang ba 'dres pa zhes// mtshan snyan por btags pa de ka yin// sems mthong ba'i mod la mnyam bzhag dngos// 'khrul phyir ma 'brang ma brgyal bar// lar sgron me ji bzhin rtag 'bar ba// tshogs drug gi snang cha gsal ba la// de la der 'dzin med pa de// rje nā ro dang mar pa'i zab zab mo// gnyid dang rmi lam gyi so mtshams na// gti mug chos skur 'char ba yi// nyams len mkhan gyis ma rnyed pa'i// rnyed pa mnyam med de khyod kyis rnyed// de ma brjed yun du goms par mdzod// dus nam zhig 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i// 'jigs pa de byung tshe mi 'jigs pa'i// thabs gcig pu de ka kho na yin// gnad de yod bar do la sogs pa'i// lam thag ring du 'gro ba'i ngal ma dgos// dus skad cig la grol lo blo bde dpal// rje nā ro dang mar mi dngos byon yang*// tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs| |don de las yod na tshol la byon// pha bka' brgyud kun gyi man ngag bcud// chos mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i nyams len rnams// tshig so sor mang yang don 'dir 'dus// mi kho bo'i khong pa'i snying phyung yang*// sha khrag gi gong bu zhig ma gtogs pa// don 'di las yod na sems can bslus// khyod nyams len du ma brjed rtsis su chongs// chos gsong por sgom pa'i rtogs ldan pa// chos dbyings mtha' bral gyis dris pa'i lan// nga skya min ser min dbur smyon zhes// padma thod phreng gis ming btags pas// tsha chu kha ru mgyogs par bris/// / ༈ /dpon slob rgyal sras kyi zhu lan/ bla ma rgyal ba'i sras pos/ kha sang nas dge sbyor skyong tshul zhig dgos gsungs byung ba da bar 'gyang song bar khrel cha mi gnang ba dang*/ zhu rgyu'i snying po/ spyir sangs rgyas nas dmyal ba'i bar gyi 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba byed po sems zhes bya ba 'di las dge sdig gi rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu bde sdug myong bar bshad mod|

rtsa ba sems nyid rtogs ma rtogs kho na la rag las pa ma gtogs/ rgyu 'bras tsam gyis kyang 'khor 'das kyi rgyu byed pa dka'/ de nas sems rtogs ma rtogs las gzhan pa sangs rgyas dus bzang du ma song*/ ngan song gi dus ngan du ma song ba ni thag chod/ sems kyi gshis la chos sku yod pa bsgoms pas rtogs pa yin/ sems la rnam rtog yod pa 'di don rtogs na chos sku yin/ ma rtogs gti mug yin/ rtogs tsa na chos sku yin/ chos sku de yod min med min gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin pa/ gsal stong 'dzin med khyab gdal ka dag /da lta'i sems nyid tha mal gyi shes pa rnam par gsal ba/ ngo bo stong pa/ mtshan nyid med pa 'di ka yin/ de las gzhan pa'i chos sku zhes pa'i 'jigs 'jigs mo gzhan med/ 'di nyid yin pa la yin par shes pa'i dran shes bag yod rgyun du bskyangs pas nyon mongs lnga ye shes lngar rtogs nas chos sku'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rtogs pa yin/ de'i mdangs 'gag med lhug par 'char ba/ dper na nyi ma las 'od 'byung ba de ka longs sku yin/ de nyid rtsal rdzogs na nges pa lnga ldan dang byas pa tsho la dka' las med/ rang mdangs de ka'i rang rtsal rol pa chu las rlabs ltar chol por 'byung ba 'di ka sprul sku yin/ de'i rtsal rdzogs na mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i mchog gi sprul sku phrin las rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ba la tshegs med pa yin/ da lta'i sgom tshul bla mas sems ngo sprad pa ltar gang shar gyi ngo bor gnas na gnas pa'i ngo bo la blta/ 'gyu na 'gyu ba'i ngo bo la blta/ gnas pa la dga' rgyu med/ 'gyu ba la sdug rgyu med/ gsal stong 'dzin med du gnas pa chos sku dang de las 'gyu ba gzugs sku gnyis yin/ bla ma tsho dang rtogs ldan tshos skyong lugs la zab zab mo mang po dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' rnams su ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba mang po dang*/ bstan bcos rnams su zhi lhag dang rnal 'byor bzhi sogs mang du gsungs kyang*/

rtsa ba'i snying po bsdus pa ngo bo tha mal gyi shes pa byung gnas 'gro gsum/ gnas 'gyu rig gsum/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum sogs bcos mas ma bslad pa'i gshis babs rjen lhang nge ba 'di ka yin/ de las bzang ngan gang 'phro yang*/ re dogs gnyis 'dzin spang blang dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed par gang shar gyi ngo bo la lta zhing gcer mthong thug 'phrad du skyong*/ bdag gir mi 'dzin/ rkyen ngan gang byung yang bcos ma'i dran rtsis mi byed/ legs na legs thog tu btang*/ nyes na nyes thog tu btang*/ a kha na kha thog tu btang*/ skyug bro na bro thog tu btang*/ bzang la mi re/ ngan la mi dogs pa'i thal byung gshis babs kho na skyong ba nyams len gyi rtsa ba byed/ de'i gegs sel bogs 'don 'phrang sgrol la bskyed rdzogs dang chos spyod gang lcogs byed/ ngo bo 'di ka sgom pa nga rang gyi nyams len sbar bcangs ma 'di ka rang yin/ 'di nyid 'khrul med yin min ci cha/ gang shar rang gi skyong lugs 'di ka yin pas dgongs bzhugs zhu zhu/ zhes pa bla ma rgyal sras kyis dgos gsungs par/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mtshams mal gyi thun mtshams su mgyogs par bris/// / yang de nyid la/ rgyal ba'i sras po'i gsung bris saṃ ṭa gnang ba'i lan 'bul dgos 'gyang tsam byung bar khrel 'khrungs med pa dang*/ don gyi snying po khrid kyi skabs zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i slad du/ dus gsum gyi rnam rtog bkag nas sems gnas cha gtso bor sgrub pa dang*/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa gcod pa lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis brtags shing dpyod pa'i skabs gnas 'gyu rig gsum/ byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas rtsa brdar bcad pa yin/ da cha de dag thams cad sems su thag chod/ sems skye med stong pa nyid du thag chod pa'i rjes su de rang gi nyams len mi dgos/ rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de ka'i ngo bo la slar lta rtog byas pa'i bcos lhad ma byas par rnam rtog de ka'i dbang du yang ma btang*/

rnam rtog 'gog pa'ang ma yin par de ka bzo med du bskyangs pas 'thus pa yin mod/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal zin na mchog tu legs pa yin te/ shi ba 'od gsal du rtogs pa la sgom med 'bring po yan chad rtogs na ma gtogs/ sgom med chung ngu man chod kyis 'chi ba 'od gsal du mi 'grub pas 'od gsal 'dzin pa 'di gal che ba yin/ 'od gsal ji lta ba zhig zin na rmi lam zin mi dgos/ 'od gsal cis kyang ma zin na rmi lam la 'bad pa gal che/ khyed rang skye ba snga ma bdag dang dpon slob tu 'brel ba lan gnyis tsam byung ba 'dra/ tsā rir 'byon dus khyis rmugs pa sogs ni 'phral gyi bar chad yin/ mos gus la ltem rkyang dang dam tshig la sel ma zhugs na/ skye ba phyi ma dpon slob tu lan 'ga' zhig yong ba'i smon lam yod/ gshin rje dang loka tri la dad pa che ba ni smon lam bzang po yod pa'i rtags yin pas da dung de ka'i mu mdzad pa gal che che/ sngar bod chos rgyal gyi rigs su 'khrungs nas sku byus 'phar 'bub byung ba 'dus byas mi rtag pa dngos bstan pa yin mod/ khyed tsam du ma zad khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos thams cad 'dus byas de ka'i rang bzhin yin/ da dung nyams len hril gyis dril na/ bla ma la mos gus/ sems can la snying rje/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa/ rang sems 'dzin med du lhug par yengs pa med par skyong ba/ dge rtsa thams cad bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa sogs gal che/ da dung zhib cha dgos byung na rjes su 'bul ba byed lags/ zhes pa mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa'i gdung rigs las byung ba bla ma rgyal ba'i sras po'i gsung bris kyi lan du| 'bri gung pa skya min ser min chos kyi grags pas bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang ba sngags kyi pho brang du bris/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris chos mdzad mar bstsal ba'i zhal gdams/ gdod nas spros bral 'dus ma byas pa gang*// glo bur nyon yid dri mas bsgribs pa dag

/rang ngo shes tsam nyid nas dag gyur pa// sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des khyod srungs// gang du rnam mkhyen gzhi gshis gnyug ma dngos// byar med lhun grub bde gshegs snying po zhes// ma byas khyab gdal rtog min mtha' dang bral// smra bsam shes brjod spros pa'i mtha' spangs pa// rgyal ba kun gyis kyang ni brjod pa'i yul// cha tsam las gzhan gsung bsnyad kyis dben pa// rang bzhin rnam dag rnyog pa dang bral ba// kun gzhi'i chos sku bum nang mar me bzhin// 'khor 'das byed po kun byed rgyal po zhes// de las gzhan med yod na gang du 'tshol// ji ltar mkha' la sprin dang rgya mtshor rlabs// man shel dwangs par tshon brgya'i rang mdangs dang*// me long ngos su gzugs brnyan la sogs pa// zur tsam mtshungs la rnam pa dpe bral ba'i// sems nyid gsal stong bar snang 'dzin bral ba// las kyi bser bus brlams pa'i rnam rtog phreng*// na bun ji bzhin lang long g.yo ba rnams// dag bya dag byed ngo bo gnyis med kyang*// shar grol la sogs phyag rgya chen po dang*// rtog ges bsres pa'i tha snyad chang gis myos// gang shar 'dzin med zhes pa ngag lam du// gleng yang don du ma go rnam rtog la// gnyen por btags pa'i rnam rtog gnyis pa spros// myos byed steng du thar med dug chu 'thung*// gnas lugs phyogs tsam go ba'i cha med kyang*// stong lta had po'i kha rbad don la gol// blun po log pa'i lam gyi ded dpon la// deng sang dus su grub chen pa zhes btags// gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i gdams pa rnams// deng sang mi gtsang khrod du nor bu bzhin// byings pa 'di ko rgyal bas kye ma gzigs// rnam rtog ma spangs de ma bkag pa la// de mi sgrub cing de la de bcos min// de yi rang ngo kho na de
