rtog gis// bsnyags pa'i 'khrul 'khor nying 'khrul mgo 'khor la// lhag mthong yin zhes snyigs dus deng sang gi// grub thob ming gis 'gro mang bslus 'di ltos// ji ltar bar snang mi shes byis pa la// rgan pos bar snang 'di zhes bstan na yang*// gnyis kas de ming tsam las de dngos med// de nyid go na de yi ngo bo stong*// ming tsam btags par zad kyi gzhi rtsa bral// de bzhin rang sems ston byed bla ma dang*// slob mar bcas pas sems zhes khar brjod kyang*// don la yin lugs go myong rtog pa bas// gzhan du ming tshig spros pa don min yang*// tshig la zhen pa'i deng sang chen po rnams// lung rig rtog btags ne tso'i ma ṇi ltar// rnam grangs du mas 'chad kyang de dag gi// go rtogs 'chad mkhan rang gi brag cha bzhin// kha nas smras la de don ma rtogs pas// sems kyi ngo bo slob mas ji ltar mthong*// sems zhes tshig kyang tshig gi rang bzhin stong*// stong pa chal chad thal phyir tha snyad pa'i// med dgag ma yin gsal la rig stong snang*// snang zhes ngo bo ma grub 'dzin zhen bral// ji ltar chu zla la sogs dper bshad kyang*// phyogs tsam mtshon mod don min bem po des| |bde gshegs snying por mtshungs na nyams re mtshar// rang sems dri bral gang snang der 'dug gi// 'dzin pa ye bral gsal stong zung 'jug dang*// phyag chen la sogs ming la ma zhen par// gang shar zhen med rang babs rang gshis su// rang rig rang gis shes pa'i gshis babs la// ma bcos dran dang shes bzhin bcos ma dang*// gnyen po la sogs dug gis ma sbags par// thad sor yeng med 'dzin med dran med dang*// rtog med bsnyon med gcer yan rang babs su// rang bzhin bzhag cing yeng med bsam med du// lhod kyis glod pas 'khor 'das gnyis mi snang*// de ltar rtogs na gang zag de ming la// ya bo smyon pa dred po chos med dang*// rkang 'dren zog po sdom shor la sogs pa// ji ltar btags kyang bla mas gang 'dod thogs// stong had cang med lta ba'i phu thag chod// gcig las gnyis spros gnyen po'i lam sgom zhing*// kha nas kun spangs don gyi 'dod sred can// mdo sngags kun dang mi mthun rbad mgo dang*// tshem bem khyi lpags dag gi mthang gos can// lta sgom spyod 'dis 'gro mang lam 'khyog por// 'khrid mkhas de la grub chen 'khrul zhig dang*// rtogs ldan bshes gnyen la sogs mtshan mang po// da lta sems can las ngan smin pa yi// 'khrul ngor brtag na bden bden ltar 'dug gi// gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos ci sems sam// gang zhig sems las gzhan pa'i chos med pa// rgyal bas gsungs mod des na sdom pa gsum// sems rtogs ngo bor dbyer med 'dzin zhen bral// de ma gtogs par kha mkhas zhud zhud kyi// dge slong byang sems sngags pa la sogs pa'i// ming yang seng lpags bkab pa'i khyi rgan de// re zhig mdzes kyang rang skad sgrog pa'i tshe// gzhan las smad pa'i yi mug de re soms// kun rdzob snang ngor 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med// don dam bden par med dang bden rgyu med// 'khor 'das rtsa ba rang sems spros dang bral// rnam par mi rtog gdod nas zhi zhing dag

/ji ltar dug can las thon yid bzhin dbang*// de bzhin rang sems dag pa'i chos skur mthong*// nor bu de nyid 'dam gyis sbags na yang*// ngo bo de nyid las gzhan gzhan min pas// dgos dgu rtsol phyir byi dor byed pa bzhin// sems nyid gdod nas dag kyang las dbang gis// 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rnam rtog rang ngo bzung*// dran dang shes bzhin gnyen po bsten mi dgos// rnam rtog skyes dang ma skyes gang snang ba// de de 'dzin med zhen med ma bsgribs par// lhod kyis glod la yeng med ngang du zhog /grub thob kun dang mthun nam ma mthun yang*// sems khral med do lam 'di nyams su longs// 'di ni deng sang 'khrul ba'i lam rnams dang*// mthun shas chung yang mar mi dwags phag gru// rin chen dpal gyis bzhed pa'i snying po yin// de dag rnams kyis nor ba ga la srid// de skad smra ba dbur stod 'bri gung pa// chos kyi grags pa 'od gsal bde chen gyi// gnyid kyis brgyal tshe mnga' ris chos mdzad mas// lhag bsam dag pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis bskul tshe// bde stong 'od gsal sgyu ma'i rang gshis dbyangs// nā da gzhom med seṅge'i sgra dbyangs 'di// 'khrul rmongs rtog ge ming tshig la zhen pa'i// grub thob wa skyes ngan pa'i klad pa 'gems// sngon byon grub chen rnam dgyes rol mor shog// /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris pa kun dga' nor bu la gdams pa/ nyams rtogs dran pa'i ngo bo stong pa la// re dogs spang blang gnyis 'dzin med pa dgos// bdag 'dzin bskyil gog gang yang med pa la// rnam rtog rang gar ma shor yeng mi dgos// rnam rtog bde sdug dran pa'i rtsol med la// nyon mongs mgo yan ma shor bya ra dgos// bdag gzhan bya ba rmi lam sgyu ma la// der 'dzin 'od gsal me yi sreg sbyong dgos// gnyid 'thug brgyal thabs lam gyi 'od gsal la// rang ngo shes pa'i rtsal sbyong bogs 'don dgos// rmi lam nying 'khrul bag chags 'khor lo la// 'dzin sprul sgyur sbyang thabs kyi bogs 'don dgos// nam langs nyams dang srab mo'i 'od gsal la| |don gyi 'od gsal rgya yis thebs pa dgos// ri klung gar sdod skyid sdug ci byung yang*// 'dzin med yeng med rtsol med lhug skyong dgos// rnam rtog snga mar phyi ma'i lhan po la// 'bad med mnyam gdal cham bde gu yangs dgos// sdug btsir mug btsir sgom gyi mu ge la// gang shar 'gag med blo bde rang grol dgos// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs dang ma rtogs la| |go rig phyed pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don dgos// ri klung bcos ma'i sgom gyis gang dus 'dir// ma bcos rang so gnyug ma'i rdzi bsang dgos// log sgom ming snyan grub chen mang dus 'dir// ming zhen bral ba'i nges don ston pa dgos// spang gnyen gnyis ka dug tu 'gro dus 'dir// rnam dbye ston mkhan dbur stod smyon pa dgos// de skad smra ba chos kyi grags pa yis| |rang gi slob bu dad ldan mnga' ris pa// kun dga' nor bu'i re ba skong slad du// mtshams mal khongs nas snying gtam smras pa yin/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /zhabs drung lcam drung gi zhu lan/ zhabs drung lcam drung gi gsung bris nges don phyag rgya chen po thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs lugs la ha cang da lta gegs sel bogs 'don zhu dgos pa'i 'phrang 'gag dang thug pa cher mi 'dug kyang*/ dang po khrid gsar gyi skabs su rnam rtog ngos bzung zhing dran pa'i gnyen po bsten pas rnam rtog kha yan du mi 'chor zhing zhi lhag gi rtog pa skye ba'i phyir dang*/ nyams la goms stobs 'byung ba'i ched yin la/ de phyin nas zhi lhag gi rtogs pa rjes mthun pa rgyud la skyes grub nas nyams len dngos gzhi sngar gong zhus pa ltar gang shar bzo med skyong ba nyid yin la/ bzo med kyi don gang shar ngos bzung ba'ang ma yin pa/ de'i rjes su'ang mi 'brang*/ bkag pa'ang min/ de la slar dran pa'i gnyen po rgyag pa'ang ma yin pa/ de ka la bcos lhad ma byas par gcer yan du bskyangs pas/ rnam rtog de ka dge sbyor du cham gyis bcos min du 'gro ba yin/ zhe sdang lta bu skyes pa'i tshe de nyid bzo med du bskyangs pas gsal stong du grol rjes kyang ma bde ka re ba de mnyam bzhag gi dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen por song yang rjes shes cung zad ma byang ba yin/ da cha rim gyis byang nas ma bde ba mi 'byung*/ ma bde ba byung yang ma bde ba de ka gcer yan du bskyangs pas rjes shes phyag rgya chen por song nas sgom mnyam rjes 'dres pa zhig 'byung ba yin/ rnam rtog phra ba smig rgyu lta bu rnams ngos 'dzin mi dgos/ de ka'ang bzo med du bskyangs pas rnam rtog phra mos nyon mongs kyi bya ba ci yang byed mi nus pas skyon med/ bskyed rim yang las dang po pa'i dus yi dam gyi zhabs phyag la gsal snang 'don pa gal che/ da cha rnam pa gsal ba tsam skad cig gis bsgoms rjes yi dam de ka rang nyid yin yin pa'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas mnyam bzhag dang ma bral ba'i bzlas brjod mdzad pa de ka sa chod che/

sngags phreng dang 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyang las rab 'byams sgrub ba'i kha sgyur tsam yin/ mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos par sngags bzla na sngags phreng dang spro bsdu mi dgos/ mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas sngags bzla na bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug las ma g.yos pa yin pas de rang legs pa yin/ mchog gi dngos grub thob na las rab 'byams shugs kyis 'grub pa/ dper na 'bras lo legs na phub sog zhar la 'byung ba dang 'dra ba yin/ sngon chad kyi thugs dam nyams len da lta phan mdzad pa 'di rnams lam rnam dag ma gtogs gol shor spu tsam yang med pa thag chod rang yin lags/ da cha sa mtshams 'di tsam du bogs 'don gal che bas skabs sbyar zhig chos drug gi nyams len mdor bsdus pa zhig gnang na/ rgya skyegs kyi tshos zhu mkhan gyis khugs pa 'dra ba zhig 'byung ba'i dus la bab 'dug lags/ de bar du nyams rtogs skye ba'i rtsa ba/ mgon po byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes gsung pas/ dad pa dag snang sbyong ba dang*/ sems can phyogs ris su ma chad pa la snying rje bskyed cing dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa'i srung sdom la 'bad/ nyams len spros bcas spros med thams cad byang chub kyi rtsis zin pa zhig gnang ba sa mtshams 'dir gal che ba'i skabs yin lags/ slad nas thugs dam gyi 'gyur ldog dang skye lugs gsal cha 'phral 'phral rim gnang zhu zhing*/ de bstun gyi gegs sel bogs 'don rim can du 'bul lugs zhu ba byed cing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i gtor bsngos ni ngos kyis zhus pa ltar yin lags/ tshes gcig la stag rtse nas phul/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bla ma sangs rin la gdams pa// gang zhig 'jig tshogs lta ba kun 'joms shing*// yod med mtha' bral bde chen dbu ma'i lam// nges don gsal mdzad dam pa gang rnams kyis// rtag par 'gro 'di bsrung ba'i dge legs stsol// rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i dal 'byor lus thob nas// rgyu 'bras tshul ldan sems pa'i nges shes kyi// thar 'dod blo yis mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i// bla ma dam pa srog dang bsdos nas btsal// rnyed nas de yi thugs sun mi dbyung bar// gang mnyes zang zing sri zhus mchod bgyid cing*// bka' bstsal mi bcag gdams pa rim gyis zhu// smin grol theg gsum lam rim drang nges chos// gnad ldan gang gsungs phu thag chod par bya// g.yel chung gal ma che dang ku re'i ngang*// zab mo'i chos dang blo 'dod mi brje bar// rdo rus gtug cing gal chen de la 'bad// de ltar gdams pa mnos nas dben pa'i sar// chos brgyad 'jig rten bya ba rbad kyis bcad// rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bza' btung gos la sogs// gal ma che kun mchil ma bzhin dor nas// dka' thub brtson 'grus srang du bcur ba ni// mgo la me shor pang du sbrul rgyug ltar| |sang byed gnangs byed mi tshe zad spangs nas// skad cig tshun du yun yang bstungs la 'bad// nyams len rtsa ba phyag rgya chen po zhes// rang sems gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku// gsal stong zung 'jug sgyu ma 'ja' tshon 'dra'i// sems kyi dngos lta tha mal 'gyu ba kun// gang shar de yi ngo bor bltas pa yis// shar grol 'dzin med sems nyid dngos su 'gyur// tha mal shes pa gang shar skyong ba las// gzhan pa'i zab zab kha bshad mang na yang*// don la 'di nyid las gzhan med pa ni// rdo rje 'chang dngos byon yang med thag chod| |dam tshig rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon nyid// khong pa'i snying ltar bzung zhing bka' bstsal bsgrub// mi brnyas mi spong gus pas spyi bor mchod// lus lha ngag sngags sems nyid ting 'dzin dang*| |'gro drug lha dang pha mar shes pa yi// stong nyid snying rje sgom pa nga yi lugs// de ltar byas na rdzogs byang 'thob par nges// zhes pa'i zhal gdams tshig nyung don mang 'di// sga pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bskul bar// dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i res bab pa// 'bri gung skyu ra skya min ser min po// rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas// sa sbrul gro bzhin dkar phyogs dga' ba la// pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba dge/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /a ce nor 'dzoms la gdams pa/ phyag rgya chen po la gegs sel bogs 'don sogs ni grub thob gong ma'i gsung sgros rnams dang*/ kho bos kyang bgyis pa'i rtog med rdo rje'i glu la ma 'thus pa cher med kyang*/ bslab bya'i snying po dal 'byor chud mi gzon pa'i thabs kyi snying po len len po len pa dang*/ 'dus byas mi rtag pas brtson 'grus brtsam/ 'khor ba'i las la snying po med pas zhen 'khris bcad/ rgyu 'bras bslu med la yid ches par bya/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la snying kha zhe med par gtad/ skyid sdug gang byung des shes mod/ lam rim pa gnyis la 'bad/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba la'ang brtson pa 'don/ rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub 'byung mi 'byung slob dpon la rag las pas srog la bab kyang rtsa ba'i dam tshig 'di las mi 'gal ba gal shin tu che bar gsungs 'dug /mdor na rang rgyud kyi dug lnga gang rags na mgo gnon ci thub/ mi dge ba phra ba tshun chad spong gang thub dang*/ dge ba phra ba tshun chad dang du len/ grogs ngan bdud kyi blo brid yin pas dbang du mi btang*/ tshe 'dir chos kyi bsam pa dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub kyi sems blo sbyong ba rnams shin tu gal che ba yin/ zhes a ce nor 'dzoms la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ /skyabs bslu med dkon mchog rin chen gsum// drin 'khor med rtsa brgyud bla ma rje// dpal lhag pa'i lha mchog zhi khro'i tshogs// rkyen bar chad sel mdzad ma mkha' 'gro// las rab 'byams grub pa chos skyong rnams// dus gtan du 'bral med bsten pa'i mthus// grogs phun tshogs nga la dge legs stsol// sngon ston pas gsungs pa'i chos 'khor la// grangs rim gsum la sogs mang mchis kyang*// nga rtog bral mkhan gyi rtogs ngo ru// don gcig las mi bdog ya re cha// khams bde gshegs snying po skad pa de// dag dang ma dag gi brjod gzhi yang*// gshis rang ngo mthong tshe bshad chos rnams// rlung bser bus brlams pa'i rtswa sbur bzhin| |de gar song cha med skyur la thong*// lar rang sems gzhi rtsa bcad bcad nas// don mtha' bral sgom tshe gnyis chos kyi// las tsab tsub mi dgos rang sar zhog

/khong bcas bcos mang na spros pa mang*// bcas bcos bzhag na spros pa 'chad// spros pa chad na ngo bo mthong*// ngo bo mthong bas rtsa ba khog /rtsa ba khog pas 'khrul ba med// 'khrul ba med pas 'khor ba spangs// 'khor ba spangs pas don 'grub snyams// don rang sems de la rang gis bltas// lta mkhan dang blta rgyu mthong rgyu kun// chos gcig pu de las gzhan yod min// gcig pu rtogs par 'dod pa na// gang yang bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang*// rang babs lhod de shig ge ba// 'bol le ba yi ngang du zhog /sgrim lhod mi dgos lhod pas chog /spang blang mi dgos bzhag pas chog /dgag sgrub mi dgos btang bas chog /bzhag na sdod pa'i nges pa med// btang na gzhan du 'gro ba min// rang babs de las gzhan yod min// hril gyis dril na de las med// don la nyams len dril bas chog /bslus na rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khrul// zhes pa'ang 'bri ban dbur smyon zhes padmas btags pa des bris so/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnal 'byor dge bsnyen la gdams pa/ gnas pa'i 'ong lugs mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu gsal cha yod pa de gnas nyams dang bsdongs pa yin/ de dag nas rnam rtog gang shar dus dran pa yang lhan skyes su yod pa de tsam gyis sgom gyi go chod/ 'on kyang rnam rtog de ka dran pa las ma 'das/ dran pa de ka'ang rnam rtog shar grol du 'gro ba zhig dgos/ de ma byung na rnam rtog shar dus slar dran pa rgyab na rnam rtog byung rjes dran pa bcos nas brgyab pas slar rnam rtog nyis brtsegs la dgos pa med/ nyin snang dang mtshan mo rmi lam sogs thams cad dbyer med gsal stong shar grol du 'gro ba zhig ci yod la lta dgos pas de ka'i sgom lugs gal che che/ zhes rnal 'byor pa dge bsnyen la gdams pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /tsan tsa chos mdzad la gdams pa/ khyed kyis thugs dam mnyam bzhag byed dus rig pa gsal dang rjen lhang nge ba 'phro rgod kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba de zhi gnas yin/

de bying rmugs gnyid kyis non pa dran pa bzung dus dran pa shed che na mnyam bzhag 'ong*/ bying rmugs shed che na mnyam bzhag mi 'ong*/ mnyam bzhag min dus res dran pa shugs 'byung du 'ong*/ res mi 'ong ba sogs da dung ma goms pa yin pas nan gyis 'bad nas bsgom pa gal che/ res 'ga' gnyid la 'gro ba ngos zin cing rmi lam cher med par skya cham me ba 'dra ba de srab mo'i 'od gsal zin la khad tsam byung ba yin 'dug /res 'ga' gnyid la 'gro ba mi tshor zhing rmi lam du 'byams pa ni bag chags shas che ba yin/ da cha re zhig skyong lugs la rnam rtog de ka'i ngo bo gcer yan 'dzin med du skyongs/ rnam rtog bkag kyang mi bkag /spro yang mi spro/ rnam rtog med par rig pa rjen gsal du byung na de ka 'dzin med du skyongs/ rnam rtog med par sems gsal stong du gnas pa la dga' rgyu med/ rnam rtog 'phro rgod byung ba la sdug rgyu med/ gang shar ba de ka la slar dran pa brgyab/ rnam rtog ngos bzung*/ de la gnyen po rgyag pa sogs bcos ma'i sgom gyi spros pa mi dgos/ rnam rtog skyes na de ka 'dzin med/ 'gag med/ de rjes mi 'brang bar rang babs su skyong ba re zhig gal che che/ de ltar bsgoms pas da lta'i skyong mtshams de la 'gyur ldog cig 'ong bas/ slar gegs sel bogs 'don gang dgos byed pa yin| zhes pa'ang tsan tsa chos mdzad kyis dris par/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dkon mchog thos pa la gdams pa/ dkon mchog thos pa'i dge sbyor skyong lugs dang the tshom de bzhin byung 'dug pa/ dge sbyor skyong sems la 'bad rtsol byas par rjes su yi rang*/ skyong lugs kyi skabs bzang ngan gyi rtog tshogs shar yang sems las byung ba yin/ sems rnam rtog tu song ba ma yin/ gang shar gyi ngo bo la bltas na ngo bo mthong rgyu med pas cung min/ gang shar 'dzin med du skyong ba yin/

'dzin med zer ba'i don de rnam rtog shar tshe de'i rjes su mi 'brang*/ de mi dgag /slar mi spro/ de gang nas byung sogs brtag dpyad mi byed par rnam rtog de ka bzo med du bskyangs pas gsal ba stong pa zung du 'jug pa zhig 'ong*/ de ka phyag rgya chen po yin/ gnas pa'i tshe ched du gnas pa la bdag 'dzin mi byed/ gong ltar bskyangs pas gnas pa dang 'gyu ba la khyad med/ phyag rgya chen po nyid yin/ rnam rtog byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs brdar sha gcod pa de khrid gsar pa'i skabs rnam rtog sems su ngo sprod phyir byas pa yin/ rnam rtog sems ngo 'phrod phyin rnam rtog cig skyes de byung gnas la brtags pas rnam rtog gis rnam rtog la phyi bsnyags byas pa la dgos pa med/ des na gnas 'gyu'am gang ltar snang sems bzo med lhug par skyong ba gal che che/ lha mthong ba sogs snang nyams yin pas bzang ngan gang yang min| bsnyen sgrub gang mos la byed pa gnad che/ rnam pa kun tu sems bzo med du skyong ba la le dbar med pa dang*/ de dag gi bogs 'don chos spyod lus ngag gi dge sbyor gang 'grub la brtson pa 'don dgos/ lus ngag gi chos spyod byed skabs sems ma bcos rang babs kyi don las ma g.yos pa gal shin tu che/ de'i skabs sems tha mal gyi rtog dbang du song na 'dus byas kyi dge bas don chen 'grub par yun ring bas/ 'dus ma byas kyi don las ma yeng bzhin du 'dus byas kyi dge ba la 'bad na 'khor 'das thams cad phyag rgya chen por grub pa gdod ma'i gshis babs yin pas 'di go ba gal che/ de'i ngang nas byams snying rje mos gus rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len rnams rten 'brel gyi gnad yin pas brtson 'grus bskyed dgos/ zhes pa dkon mchog thos pa'i bslab byar 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /yang mu stegs pa la gdams pa/ dbus mtha' 'khob mu stegs yul la sogs// gang du skyes kyang bde gshegs snying po la// bzang ngan med phyir lam 'di sus bsgoms pa// mya ngan 'da' ba gshis sam babs su nges// dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag las 'bras dang*// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs kyis yid skyo bas// skyabs sems maṇḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs// lam gyi sngon 'gro rnams la legs sbyangs nas// byams dang snying rje'i rgyu byas byang chub sems// rnam gnyis phyin drug bsdu dngos bslab pa gsum| |phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs rjes// rmi lam dbang thob dam tshig srog ltar bsrung*// bskyed rim rdzogs rim chos kun sgyu ma ltar// lta zhing de kun 'od gsal mes sbyangs nas// bde stong zung 'jug lam la rtag rol zhing*// 'khor 'das chos dang chos can gang dang gang*// rmi lam ltar mthong gang shar rtog pa'i tshogs// tshor drug bcas pa gang shar der snang rnams// slad la mi bzo sdang bas mi dgag cing*// der 'dzin mi byed gang yin gtad med du// ye 'byams klong gdal ngang du bzo med pa// lhod kyis glod nas yeng med nyid du bsgom// rdo rje 'chang dang shāka thub pad 'byung sogs// gcig tu gros kyang 'di las lhag pa'i lam// ston rgyu 'dug na kho bos sems can bslus// de skad smra bo thugs kyi rdo rje zhes// ming gzhan chos kyi grags pa zhes pa ngas// mu stegs rigs 'chang khyod kyis bskul ba'i ngor// sum mdo gzhung du gang dran bris par zad/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /dkon mchog snying rje la gdams pa/ rje bla ma'i zhabs rdul rdo rje'i gar// mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug gdan yangs por// dus rtag tu bkod nas bsod snyoms pa// khyod dkon mchog snying rjes dris pa'i lan// dus de ring bsnyad do rna bas nyon// lar bskyed rim kho nar zhen chags pa// yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs// sngon gtam rgyud mang po gsungs pa'i phyir// mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa kho bos spangs| |yang stong nyid kho na bsgoms bsgoms pas// rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye ba zhes// rdo rje'i theg pa'i rgyud nas gsungs// don de phyir 'khor 'das chos thams cad// stong nyid du blta ba'i kho thag bcad// nyams ban bun gyi mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang*// sems gsal stong 'dzin med du mthong tsam gyis// grub chen dang rtog ldan yin no lo// bun skyed dang khe tshong la nyams len byed// shi gson gyi mgo bo skor ba yi// chos brgyad kha yan gyi zog rdzu 'di// rang gzhan bslu brid kyi rtogs ldan dang*// grub chen gyis sa steng gang mthong nas// grub chen gyi kho thag de nas chod// na bza' chos gos dang sham thabs bcings// lhung bzed 'khar gsil phyag na thog /bsam ngan dang 'dod chags me ltar 'bar// de 'dra'i dge slong mang mthong nas// btsun pa'i kho thag gting nas chod// kha 'jam gting rtsub dug lnga 'bar// blo 'dod che la jo bo ngan// chags sdang dang khe grags can rnams kyis// bdag gzhan brje bar byed do lo// de 'dra de dag mthong bas na// byang sems kyi kho thag rbad kyis chod// dam tshig dang mi ldan rgyu ma mthong*// rdor dril gyi de nyid kyang mi shes pa'i// dbang bskur dang chog gyer gyis sa steng gang*| |sngags pa'i kho thag de yis chod// don de bas nyams len 'di ltar byed// 'khor 'das la re dogs spang blang med// rgyu 'bras la yid ches dang du len// dam tshig la ngo lkog med par bsrung*// 'gro drug la phan sems lam bzang ston// rang lus las gces pa'i dngos po kun// g.yar po ltar rtag 'dzin 'du shes spang*// gang gis chog pa'i nor rdzas 'dzin// rnam rtog dang skyid sdug legs nyes kun// gang shar de bzo med chal pa'i ngang*// bden 'dzin dang der 'dzin med pa ru// bzo bral du yengs med ma yeng bsgom// don de ltar khyod kyang sgom pa mdzod// tshig de skad smras pa skyu ra'i rigs// gtad med kyi chos grags zhes pa ngas// khyod dkon mchog snying rjes bskul ba'i ngor// sum mdo gzhung du bris pa yin/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//

༈ /bla ma lho pa sprul sku dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal kyi zhu lan/ pha rdo rje 'chang dbang chos kyi rje// mtshan bi da ra ṇa zhes grags pa'i// slar bka' drin dran no gsol ba 'debs| |bu chos bzhin bskyangs pa chos ltar 'tshar// khyed dkon mchog phrin las zhes bya bas// dus de ring rtogs pa'i brgya 'bul byas// 'di zang zing phal gyi do zla min// don de la dge slong rgan bu yis// gshis rang babs kyi go don 'di skad lo// sems bzod nas chos sku yin pa la// byis pa dar ma rgan dus su// don de la khyad par ngas ma mthong*// sems lus dang bcas sam ma bcas kyang*// dpe kun dang bral ba'i don dam de// lar 'dus ma byas pa mtha' las 'das// de 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po dngos// sems gdod ma'i mgon po dri bral la| |rkyen glo bur dri ma rnam rtog kyang*// dpe nam mkha' la ni chu 'dzin ltar// 'phral ji ltar snang yang gos pa med// sems rtog med kyi skabs su bde bde bo// rnam rtog shar tshe mi bde ba| |de kun rdzob 'khrul blor bden bden ltar// don dam par bde dang mi bde med// ltas gang ltar byas kyang spu tsam med// sems rang ngo mtha' bral 'dus ma byas// de gsal snang tshogs drug hrig hrig po// nyams ci yang 'char ba'i nges nges po// don bden par gzhal na ngo bos stong*// dpe mar me'i snang ba zur tsam gyis// mun stug po thams cad snang bar 'char| |don de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal mes// yongs bden bden 'dra ba'i tshogs nags tshal// lar skad cig me yi dngos las min// don de la mgon po ma pham pas// rkyen glo bur dri ma ngo bos stong*// gshis rigs khams rtag brtan yin par gsungs// lar rnam rtog phra ba rgyu rgyu po// des don byed mi nus rang sor zhog /dug rang pa'i 'dzin stangs shar ba na// tshul de la sdang ltas byas pa na// sems nyid la sems nyid kyi sdang ltas te// de gsor mi rung ba'i dug chen yin// rkyen rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang*// tshul de phyir mi 'brang de mi dgag

/de bzo med du glod la gcer gyis blta// lta mkhan dang blta bya lta byed gsum// lar don du gcig la tshur mthong gi// byis blor spu ris shig de na 'byed| |de 'khrul blo yin gyi don la min// don snying po sbar bcangs su byed pa na// rkyen bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang ji snyed// chos spyod dang rim gnyis a 'thas blo// nyon mongs kyi rtog pa lam lam pa// tshul ji 'drar snang yang rang babs su// khong lhod kyis glod la shig gis bzhag /don rtsir gyis bzung la gcer gyis ltos// de 'od gsal gyi ngang du cham me ba// gshis stong pa nyid du sang nge ba// gdangs 'gag pa med par hrig ge ba// rtsal phyogs lhung med par wal le ba// don 'pho 'gyur med par shig ge ba// de rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs shul yin// bka' 'khor lo bar mtha' rgyu 'bras kyi// chos theg pa'i lam srol mtha' yas pa'i// don 'di las med par thag bcad nas// pha ngas kyang bsgoms pas 'khor 'das dang*// gzhi lam 'bras dus kyi dbye ba sogs// tshig tha snyad kyi ngal khur ma dgos par// don rang gshis chos sku gdeng dang bcas// sa 'gyur med kyi btsan rdzong zin pa yin// bu khyod kyang de ltar sgom mdzod dang*// dus mi ring nye bar phas phog pa'i// chos pha 'bab mi dman gyi rdzong btsan de// som nyi mi dgos zin nas 'ong*// tshul 'di ni rang re'i chos kyi sras// mtshan dkon mchog phrin las kyis bskul ngor// rigs skyu ra'i dge slong rgan bu ba// don 'khor 'das chos skur gdeng thob pa// ming dbur smyon ces byar padmas btags// 'phral chos kyi grags pa 'bod des bris/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /paṇa chen rin dbang gis dogs gcod gnyis zhus pa'i dang po'i lan ni/ paṇa chen rin dbang gis nyams myong saṃ ṭar 'khod pa de nyid snga sor dge sbyor la rgyun bskyangs shing nan tan byas pas 'gyur ldog che bar byung ba de la bogs thon pa zer ba yin/

khrid gsar pa'i dus kyi zhi gnas la bde gsal gyi nyams shar ba'i skyong bde mo des pho skyes mi byed/ da lta dran pa byas kyang byed rgyu mi 'dug bsam pa'i cham gdal de'ang dran pa yin mod/ shugs 'byung gi dran pa dang 'gyu ba lhan skyes me dang du ba lta bu de ka la da dung rgyun bsrings nas bsgom/ bsgom bya sgom byed mi 'dug snyam na'ang de ka'i ngang du bsgoms nas slar yang 'gyur ldog cig byed 'ong*/ gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal la dran rtsis dang 'gyu ba byung na 'od gsal min/ gnyid 'thug gi brgyal thabs de med par rmi lam dang 'gyu dran ci yang med par zla 'od shar ba ltar gsal cham de 'od gsal yin mod/ shi ba'i 'od gsal dang khyad med/ da dung 'bad pas bsgom na 'gyur ldog 'ong bas gsal cha 'phral 'phral mdzod dang*/ gegs sel bogs 'don ci shes gang shes rim gyis 'bul ba yin lags/ phyi ma'i lan gdab pa ni/ skyabs bslu med blo gtad pher ba de// don dam pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// khong dmigs gtad bral ba'i mgon po de// ye gdod ma'i sangs rgyas yin no zhes// skyabs de 'dra gang du bzhugs gyur pa// yid dung dung mos pa'i dad gus dang*// gnas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la 'jigs pa'i// sems ci drag la thug pa'i rtsad bcad pas// don rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// drin gzhal du med pa rigs kyi bdag /mtshan brjod na rnam 'joms phun tshogs nyid// khyod 'khor ba'i gnas la yid 'jigs na// gnas de las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas ni// 'dus byas kyi sangs rgyas la sogs pa// blo 'khrul ngor snang yang 'jig pa'i phyir// skyabs de 'dras skyob par mi nus kyi// chos bdag 'dzin can gyi tha snyad tshig /bdag med zer yang bdag gis bcings// nad 'tsho ba'i sman yang dug lta bu// yang rig grol gyi dge 'dun yin no lo// gos dmar ser 'dzin pa'i thugs rgyud kyang*// lar dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba tsam// lar de 'dra'i dkon mchog rnam pa gsum| |ltar snang gi ming la yid gtan med// skyabs de 'dra thal ba'i la btsas 'dra// nga 'khor ba las skyob pa'i skyabs kyi mchog

/rgyud tha dad ma yin rang la bzhugs// sems gsal stong mtha' bral chos kyi sku// chos bden gnyis zung 'jug brjod las 'das// mdangs 'gag med ye gshis dge bar 'dun// don de 'dra'i skyabs gnas yod do zhes// dpal nā ro'i chos drug rdo rje'i lam// zab mo rgyud sde'i gnad sems can// khong rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi dpyid// dpal shes rab bzang por gang bab la// nā ro paṇa chen las 'ongs pa// rje lho brag mar pa'i bka' drin gyis// mi nga bar khyi yis ma chod pa// don lhan skyes kyi nor bu rang gis rnyed// don de 'dra rdzogs shing thos pa'i tshe// lar chos la mtha' dbus med na yang*// rgyud sde'i snying por khas 'che ba'i// ni gu dang lam 'bras la sogs pa// sngon grub chen gyi gzhung bzang 'o ma'i mtsho// dus snyigs ma'i zog po 'ga' 'ga' yis// ngan lhad dug chus sbags 'di rnams// mthong thos kyang yid gtan byed mi dgos// don de phyir paṇa chen rin dbang gi// nyams rtogs pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don pa// gnad zab dgu smras kyi dga' bas longs// nga gdams ngag gnad zab mi mchis rgyu// pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i bka' drin yin// nga tha snyad chos la mi mos pa// dus deng sang gi thal phyir rtog ge ba| |dmyal khams su rings khyad che 'di rnams// mthong zhing thos pas der ma mos// don rtsa bar dril na 'di ltar yin// 'gro 'dug sogs spyod lam gang byed kyang*// rnam rtog yod dang med pa la// mnyam bzhag gi dbyings su khyad ma mchis// yengs dang ma yeng zhes bya ba// lam gsar pa'i dus su de skad ces// btags kyang don du dbye ba bral// gnyid 'thug dang rmi lam sang dus sogs// cung zad yengs pa ltar snang ba// da dung goms cha chung ba tsam// don goms na yeng bya yeng byed med// rnam rtog dang dran pa yeng bya sogs// yeng med dang mnyam bzhag 'dzin med sogs// ming so sor btags kyang ngo bo gcig

/dran mdangs dang 'gyu shar ngo bo dang*// rjen hrig dang dwangs yer la sogs pa// phyogs zur tsam mtshon pa'i ming brda tsam| |dpe 'di dang gtor ma chos skabs sogs// rtsol bcas kyi dran pa dgos pa yang*// cung zad dge sbyor shugs chung bas// yeng cha phran bu byung ba de// don yengs dang ma yeng ngo bo la| |khyad par 'dug na 'khrul ngor thal// khyad ma mchis na sgom go chod// gnyid 'thug ces pa brgyal thabs min// dran bsam tshugs na brgyal ba med// rnam rtog la dran pa brgyab pa des| |mnyam bzhag dang rjes shes gnyis su song*// rnam rtog dang dran pa tha mi dad// dus rgyun 'chad med pa'i dran pa yin// gnyid 'thug brgyal ba'i dus su yang*// ting ting skad kyis bskul ba'i tshe// dran pas zin pa gnyen po'i stobs// 'on kyang skad kyis ma bskul tshe// mi dran pa de brgyal ba'i nyams// de phyir de la nan tan bya// 'byung ba'i thim rim phra dang rags// rags pa nyi shu la sogs pa// gnyid kyi skabs su cha 'dra tsam// mtshan nyid tshang ba mi 'byung yang*// snang mched thob pa la sogs pa// 'byung phyir de nyid ngos zin bya// gnyid 'thug dran med ngos zin cing*// de yang 'khrul ngor ma song ba// zhi gnas kyi ngang du 'jog thub pa// gnyid kyi 'khrul ba rang sar zhi// 'chi tshe thim rim ngos zin nas// brgyal thabs kyi dbang du ma song bar// lhan skyes 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs de// rang ngo zin par 'jog thub de// bar do la sogs bgrod ma dgos// sems gnyug ma'i rang so zin pa na| |skye shi zhes pa 'khrul ba'i ngo*// gzhan ngor skye shi ltar snang yang*// rang nyid sems kyi rang mdangs tsam// rnam rtog yin gyi grub pa med// gnyid kyi thim rim ma zin cing*// stong bzhi'i tha ma rang gshis su// 'jog par ma thub dus tha ma'i// thim rim ma zin de yi mthar// dran med 'od gsal ma zin na// nyams dang rtogs pa mtho skad kyang*// bar do'i 'phrang la 'byon par nges// rtogs pa goms pa'i 'bras bu yis// bar dor 'khrul ba mi 'byung yang*// 'byon thag ring phyir 'o re brgyal// skad cig tha ma de mthong na// 'phrang ring po'i skor thag mi dgos pa'i// rnal 'byor gyi mgyogs lam de na yod// don ma go ba la byed thabs zad// tshe 'dir rang mgo rang skor ba'i// tha snyad la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa dang*// don stong bzhi lam du ma lhong ba'i// sems stong par bsgoms pa'i sgom chen dang*// sku gsum lam du mi 'khyer ba'i// bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa'i sngags pa dang*// tshe stong tshad dal 'byor chud zos mkhan// gnam ske gon gyi nyi zla rdog rol mkhan// de rnams kyi mgyogs pa rkang mgyogs kyi// grub thob kyis kyang mi sleb pa'i// 'gyod thal gyi thang zhig de na yod// sems skye med yin phyir 'chi ba med| |de chos sku yin par gdod nas grub// 'chi ba med phyir skye ba med// de sprul sku yin pa gshis kyi babs// de gnyis su med phyir rang mdangs tsam// longs sku yin par thag gis chod| |sems bzo med rlung gi rta la zhon// rlung de nyid skye 'gag byas tsam la// ming 'dogs mkhan gyis skye shi btags// lus sems 'brel ba'i las rlung la// srog ces de 'gags shi ba zhes// phal pa blun po'i brjod byar nges// rlung sems dbu mar bcings pa'i tshe// srog dhū tir thim zhing tha ma'i sems// nyi zla'i rgyu ba de 'gag tshe// zhon pa med pa'i zha bo bzhin| |sems rta pho rlung dang bral ba'i tshe// bzo med lhug pa zhig de na yod// de mthong tshe rang sems brtan pa thob// tshe 'di phyi'i dbye ba 'byed ma dgos// ming ji skad 'dogs kyang de la thogs// gnad de la thos na thos pa'i mchog

/dpe rul thos pa gang bder bzhud// tshul de bzhin gyi yin lugs bsam pa'i mchog /tha snyad kyi 'og 'gyu ci bder mdzod// don de 'dra bsgoms pa bsgom bya'i mchog /yin rlom gyi 'jog sgom nga la med// lam mgyogs skor drang po zhig 'di na yod// drang don gyi lam skyog der thams cad 'byon| |'o brgyal nyam thag ya re cha// tshul 'di 'dra go yul du ma bzhag par// rang nyams thog tu bkal ba gzhan drin med// dus skad cig gcig gi gnas skabs der// dus gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtse mo yod// tshogs gsog sdig sbyong gi ngal ba med// don ma mthong ba la mdzad rgyu bzang*// dus da lta'i bzang bzang 'jam 'jam dang*// dul dul dang chos brgyad kyi gar nyams mkhan// 'khor dang zang zing gi tshogs dpon tsho// bar do'i 'phrang la chas pa'i tshe// glang chen smyon pas zos ji bzhin// nying 'khrul gyi ngang du ci bder gshegs// de skad ces pa 'brel med kyi// chos gtam mang du bris pa yang*// paṇa chen rin chen dbang rgyal gyi// nyams rtogs gegs sel bogs 'don du// khong pad 'byung zhes pa'i 'chol po des// mi ma skyes gong nas ming btags pa// dbur smyon zhes pa'i gtad med po// skyu ra'i gdung las son pa des// gnas bye ri stag rtser bris pa yin/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sman sgom brag chen par gdams pa/ pha bka' brgyud bla ma byin rlabs can// mi kho bo'i snying dbus rtag tu bsten// khyed gzhan phan gso dpyad mthar phyin nas// bdag don du sgrub pa lhur byed pa'i// sman sgom brag po che ba yis| |lta sgom spyod pa la dor ba'i// thag chod kyi gtam snyan kho bos thos// sems dang ba'i dga' spro ci yang 'phel// don de la gsal 'debs tshig gsum byed// blta bya dang bya byed bral ba yi// gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi spros bral de// rang stong dang gzhan stong gis ma bslad par// lta ba'i mthar thug de la mdzod// bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba yi// gsal stong bcos min rang ngo shes// gang shar 'dzin med lhug pa nyid// sgom pa'i mthar thug de la mdzod// spyod bya dang spyod byed blang dor gnas// re dogs kyi dra bar ma 'thums par// thug 'phrad chu la dbyug bsnun ltar// spyod pa'i mthar thug de la mdzod// gzhi lam 'bras bu la sogs pa// 'thob bya dang thob byed bzang ngan la// spang blang re dogs med pa yi// rang sems rang ngo shes grol ba// 'bras bu'i mthar thug de la mdzod// don de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// mtha' bral gyi lta ba goms pas dben// bcos min gyi sgom la shor sa med// gnyis med kyi spyod par thob shor med// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu la// spang blang med do sman sgom che// skye shi bar do 'khor 'das kun// kun rdzob 'khrul ngor ci yang snang*| |don dam bden par ci la grub// sems sgyu lus lha ru shar ba dang*// 'od gsal klong du thim pa la// rtog ges skye shi bya bar btags// nga rnal 'byor smyon pa'i snang ba la// gang yang ma grub gdod nas dag

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rang cha yin// don de ltar dgongs mdzod grogs dam pa// lha dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*// rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden tshig gis| |rtsod dus kyi sman sgom khyod nyid kyi// 'gal rkyen nad gdon zhi ba dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa dang*// sgom yun shi dang mnyam pa dang*// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang 'thob pa ru// bdag gis khyod la smon lam btab// mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// dad ldan dam gtsang mos gus dang*// lhag bsam dag pa 'dzoms pa 'dis// smon lam 'grub par gdon mi za// don de ltar sman sgom brag chen pas// nyams rtogs thag chod kyi brgya 'bul byas// de byas pa'i rna bar dbur smyon ngas// yin lugs thag gcod kyi gsal 'debs tsam// tshig nyung la 'khyer bde yig tshogs chung*// don zab rgyas mang ba mdo sngags kyi// gnad ma tshang med pa de ring bsrings// don de 'dra mkha' mnyam sems can gyis| |dus ma 'gor myur du rtogs par shog// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpon btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ dpon btsun gyi thugs dam skye lugs/ lam la zhugs pa'i dus na rnam rtog rags shing 'phro rgod pa zhig yod 'dug pa de la skyong tshul ji lta ba zhig byung na nyams rtogs rlabs chen zhig 'byung ba'i tshad du 'dug kyang*/ snga sor khrid gsar gyi dus gnas cha 'tshol ba la rnam rtog bcad nas zhi gnas la ci gnas su 'jog pa'i skabs dang*/ de rjes lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis sems dang sems byung sogs phra rags thams cad rtsad bcad nas myong ba phra zhib can 'ong bar byed pa dang*/ de rjes sems byung snang ba rnam rtog thams cad sems su thag chod/ sems gnas 'gyu dbyer med du thag chod/ de'ang spros bral bden med du thag chod par byas nas/ dge sbyor skye lugs dang bstun pa'i skyong lugs gang la gang 'tsham du bla ma myong ba can gyi ngag ltar byed pa ni phyag rgya chen po bsgom par gal shin tu che/

khrid gsar pa rnam rtog gang skyes ngos bzung*/ dran pa brten/ gnyen po brgyab pas rnam rtog dge sbyor du song zer ba'i rnam rtog la rnam rtog gi rtseg ma brtsegs pa'i skyong lugs byas par nyams len go chod pa gang 'ong*/ gdul bya so sor khams ris dbang po tha dad par gnas skabs kyi nyams rtogs skye tshul yang mi 'dra ba 'ba' zhig 'ong bas gang 'tsham du ngo ma sprad par de mus la skyong zer ba byas pas gang yang mi 'byung*/ des na sems ngo 'phrod kyi skyong lugs sdug btsir sgrim cha byas kyang yon tan las skyon bskyed pa mang*/ da cha snga lugs kyi sgrim cha mi byed par sems gnas pa dang*/ rnam rtog phra rags gang byung yang rang sar lhod kyis glod/ cham gyis bzhag /gnas pa la dga' rgyu med/ 'gyu ba la sdug rgyu med/ gnas na gnas thog de kar bzo bcos dgag sgrub med par rang babs ma yeng tsam gyi ngang nas ce re/ gsal le/ hrig ge ba de kar lhod de bzhag /rnam rtog phra rags gang byung yang rnam rtog skyes byung*/ rnam rtog red snyam pa'i der 'dzin mi byed/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo la lta ba sogs dgag bya mi byed/ rnam rtog de la slar phyi 'brangs byas pa'i gcig las gnyis 'phros kyi bzo bcos kyang mi bya/ rnam rtog gang byung de ka la dgag sgrub spang blang gang yang mi byed par de ka'i ngang du ma yeng bar lhod de bzhag pas kho rang phyag rgya chen po yin/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ 'gyu ba dngos med rlung dang 'dra// 'dzin pa ma zhugs 'gyus pas chog /ces gsungs pa yin/ don la 'gyu ba bde sdug tshogs drug gi snang ba spyod lam rnam bzhi 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug bza' btung gnyid rmi lam mngon sum nyin mtshan dus thams cad du rang sems la rang sems kyi rgyang so ma yeng tsam/ ma brjed tsam/ ma bor tsam gyi ca ga wal tsam/ hrig tsam/ tur tsam/ dran tsam dus kun tu byed pa ma gtogs dge sbyor skyong dus lus gnad lta stangs kyi ngang nas bzang bzang mor byed/

de min dus gang byung gi rkyen dbang du btang bas ci yong*/ rang gi sems rang gis bsgom pa la dus tshod dang lus gnad sogs la ltos mi dgos pa yin/ dus kun tu bzo med kyi dran rig ma yeng bar byed pa gal che/ sems dang rnam rtog chu dang chab rom 'dra// chu 'dod chab rom mi 'dod chu yin pa// sus kyang mi smra de bzhin sems dang ni// rnam rtog dag kyang sems nyid rnam rtog dngos// rnam rtog sems yin sems dang sems byung zhes// sgro btags tsam las don du dbye ba med// chu la lbu ba rdol tshe de gnyis po// so sor snang yang lbu ba bzung ba na// chu las dbu ba logs su med pa ltar// sems la rnam rtog shar tshe so so ltar// snang yang sems las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog med// de phyir sems byung bkag nas sems bsgom pa// gsor mi rung ba'i dug yin de bas na// gang shar 'dzin med ma yeng tsam gyi ngang*// sdug btsir sgrim sgrim mi dgos rang babs su// lhod kyis glod nas gu yangs brjod bral du// rang gshis rang babs 'jog pa kho bo'i lugs// 'di ltar bsgom na khyed kyi da lta yi// dge sbyor de la 'gyur ldog myur du 'byung*// de phyir de ka'i mus la skyongs shig pa'i// thabs rdugs ngo sprod de 'drar ma re bar// nyams myong can gyi ngag la ltos pa na// myur du rang so thub pa'i rnam rtog 'byung*| |zhes pa dpon btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis nyams rtogs skyong lugs dgos gsungs par/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong 'khor 'das rang sems spros bral du rtogs pa chos kyi grags pas/ gzhu stod gter sgrom brag dkar gyi gnas 'dabs chu tshan khar mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' ris sgrub chen par gdams pa/ brjod las 'das pa brjod bya'i snying po rnams// rang la med kyang rang nyams dang bstun nas// mnga' ris sgrub pa lhur len la phan phyir// chos kyi grags pas yi ge'i lam du spel// mnga' ris sgrub chen pas bskul ngor gtso bor bgyis shing*// nges don phyag rgya chen po la chos blo byed pa rnams la sman pa'i slad du bslab bya phran bu zhig ma nus bzhin du bgyi na/

rgyal ba'i bka' rnams nas gsungs pa'i lung dang*/ 'phags yul dang bod du byon pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi nyams myong slob ma'i don du gsungs pa ches mang ba dang*/ mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi dpyad sgom tha snyad kyi dgag sgrub bshad pa gtso bor ston pa rnams ni nyi ma dang zla ba ltar ches cher rmad du byung yang*/ blo dman rnams kyis rtogs dka' la 'jug pa'ang mi bde la/ yang goms stobs myong ba yod par rlom zhing dpe 'khyar gyi tshig 'ga' tsam sna bsdus shing myong can 'ga'i tshig phyir 'brangs pa rang gi myong stobs yin zhes/ brag cha'i stong sgra ltar smra zhing snying pos dben pa rnams kyis ni brtson ldan la myong ba rim gyis skyes pa'i tshe nad pa'i gam du spre'us sman sgro thogs te sman par khas 'che ba ltar ci bya gtol med du 'gyur ba'ang mang du mthong ngo*// des na rang nyid skyes stobs dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan ni chu shing ltar snying pos dben zhing gnyis med seṅger gyur kyang*/ gangs can ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin cing spel ba'i ring lugs thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan/ 'gran zla dang bral ba dwags po bka' brgyud du grags pa'i dam pa gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun gyis yongs su rgyud brlan cing*/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen 'ga' zhig tu skye ba'i snang brnyan bzung ba'i goms stobs bag chags kyi myong ba da lta rang rgyud la gla rtsi dang shun pa'i dpe ltar gyur pa nyid rim gyis smras na/ slob ma mchog 'dod dad ldan rnams la phan par mchis pas 'di skad lo/ de'ang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi byed po sems zhes bya ba rlung ltar 'gyu ba 'di ni lung dang rig pa tha snyad skyes sbyangs kyi stobs la sogs pa rnams kyis 'di'i ming don tsam 'phrod cing yin lugs shes pa tsam las gzhan pa'i snying po dpyis phyin pa rtogs par mi srid la/

goms pa lhur byas pa'i stobs kyis rtogs pa kho nar mchis mod/ de la goms pa lhur byed pa la sgom dgos pas/ dang po rang sems la gzhig pa ma bcug pa'i gong du ni ci yin 'di yin med pas ngo ma shes pa yin la/ thog mar sems la bltas pa'i tshe sngar las 'phro rgod cher song ba 'dra zhig 'byung mod/ de ni sngar las 'phro rgod cher song ba min yang rtog 'jug byas pas 'phro rgod 'dug pa ngos zin pa tsam yin/ de rjes khams nyog pa ltar 'gyu dran med cing brgyal ba ltar gnas pa chags pa ni sngar 'gyu dran ngos bzung bas thang chad cing shes pa nyog pas dran cha mi gsal zhing sngar rlung mi 'jug pa'i rtsa 'ga' rer rlung zhugs pas brgyal ba ltar gyur pas gnas pa la ming btags kyang don brgyal ba dang 'dra zhing*/ 'di'i skabs su shi na rje sa paṇa bzhed pa'i 'gog pa dang dud 'gro gzugs med khams sogs su skye ba de yin/ de'i mod la sad nas dge sbyor skye lugs mang yang*| 'dir shas che ba brjod na sems gsal la stong pa ngos bzung med pa dwangs sang nge ba yun bag tsam 'byung ba ni zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa yin/ phar phyin theg pa ba rnams 'di la gtsigs che bar 'dug kyang sa chod cher mi 'dug /de'i ngang nas 'gyu ba thol gyis byung ngos zin cing gnas pa'i cha'ang ngos zin pa la skyong bde zhing rig pa rang bzhin gyis dwangs pa zhig 'byung la rgyun ring thung la ni nges pa med do// de ni skabs 'di'i lhag mthong yin/ de nyid rgyun bsrings pas sngar bas skyong bde zhing 'gyu dran thams cad la dran rtsis zin cing gsal stong 'dzin med du cham cham 'gro ba la/ rang yang 'di las lhag pa'i dge sbyor 'ong rgyu mi 'dug bsam pa zhig 'byung ba ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin zer mkhan 'dug kyang*/ 'di la 'gyur ldog ma byung na skyong bde ba tsam las sa chod chen po mi 'byung*/ de'i ngang nas 'gyu ba sprin dang spos kyi du ba ltar breng breng snang zhing de nyid la byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad bcad pas gcad bya gcod byed dang bral bar rang rang gi ngo bos stong zhing*/

stong tsam nyid nas 'gyu ba thol gyis 'byung ba la bltas pas rjen lhang nge 'byung ba de sems ngo shes pa tsam yin yang 'di nas 'bad rtsol ma byas na sems ni stong pa yin/ de'i ngang las 'gyu ba 'byung*/ 'gyu ba'i ngo bo la bltas tsa na stong gsal rjen par song ba 'di sems kyi ngo bo yin/ bsgoms kyang 'di ka yin ma bsgom yang 'di ka yin zer thag bcad nas ske la ri mo bris nas ma bsgom par bsdad pas sems ngo shes shing ngo bo ma mthong ba rgyu 'bras la mi rtsi bar kha po che ba rtogs ldan rgyal khams kyi phung bshig mgo ril dred po lcags rkang ba tsho byung ba yin/ de nyid 'bad pas bsgoms pas skyong bde zhing sems la bde ba'i cha chen po 'byung*/ de la ma chags par bsgoms pas stong pa'i ngang nas gsal ba'i mdangs yod pa bde ba de'ang stong par shar ba zhig 'byung*/ de la ma chags par bsgoms pas bde ba'i cha dang gsal ba'i cha gnyis ka'ang ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral zhing yul yul can gang la'ang mi rtog pa zhig 'byung*/ 'ga' zhig 'di'i mi rtog pa la rtogs ldan du ming btags/ spyod pa kha yan du btang nas gzhan la khrid 'debs/ rang yang rtogs ldan du kha po che ba byed 'dug pa ni char pa med pa'i 'brug sgra dang 'dra/ yud tsam zhig nas rtogs pa de gnas 'gyur nas sngar khrid ma zhus pa'i skabs las skyong ma bde zhing thabs sdug pa zhig 'byung bas de'i tshe 'gyod pa'i ngang du lus pa zhig 'ong*/ mi rtog pa de la ma chags par bsgoms pas stong nyid kha yan du mi shor zhing nyon mongs mgo yan du ma shor ba tsam 'byung*/ de'i tshe gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang byung yang gang shar de'i ngo bo la bltas pas mthong tsam nyid nas rang grol du sang sang 'gro zhing skyong ma bde ba med pa 'byung bas 'di nas bzung ste skyong bde zhing sgom skyon cher mi 'ong*/ de'i ngo bo la lta zhing yun bskyangs pas rnam shes drug po sems la mi 'brang zhing sems kyang rnam shes drug po'i dbang du mi 'gro ba zhig 'ong*/

de la yun bskyangs pas sems nyid 'dzin med kyi ngang nas 'gyu dran rnams la bcos pa'i dran pa cher mi dgos pa la 'gyu ba de byung 'phral dran rtsis la brtson 'grus kyi lcag dgos pa zhig 'ong*| 'di'i skabs 'gyu ba rgod du song na ma bkag par gar 'gror btang bas 'gro sa med par rang gshis su grol/ bying na bying thog tu btang bas bying ba nyid sgom du 'char/ rgod na'ang rgod thog tu btang*/ rmugs na'ang rmugs thog tu btang bas sgom gyi ngang du log 'ong ba dper na chab rom chags pa dang*/ drag por 'bab pa dang*/ dal por rgyu ba dang*/ 'khyil ba sogs gang byas kyang sa dbyibs dang nam zla'i 'gyur ba ma gtogs ngo bo chu las mi 'gyur ba'ang 'dra/ skabs 'dir rtogs pa kha yan du skyong zhing sgom chen gyi 'phrang nga bdag ces bya ba de 'dir ker gyis langs nas ka pā la thogs/ sgom thag gyon/ khyi lpags rkub la dkris/ rkang dung 'bud/ ral cog bcings/ yang na rbad mgo tshem bem gyon nas stong pa kha 'byams kyis rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod cing nga nga nga zhes bsgrags pas dmyal ba'i gting du mgo 'jog 'jog bskal pa mang por sdod pa'i nyen shin tu che ba zhig gi skabs 'ong bas/ de'i tshe ngar 'dzin dang stong nyid de'i ngo bor lta zhing rgyu 'bras phra mo la rtsis gdab btang*/ bsags sbyang la 'bad cing lhag par bla ma la dbang mang du zhu zhing nyams len bskyangs pas sngar gyi bdag 'dzin dang stong lta de nam mkhar sprin dwangs pa ltar song rjes sems kyi ngo bo de sngar nas grub ma myong zhing ngo bo ngos bzung med pas yod pa ma yin pa/ med bzhin du gzugs sogs drug po rang mdangs rang rtsal du snang bas med pa'ang ma yin pa/ sems dang snang ba gnyis ka 'di yin 'di min rtsis gdab rgyu dang rkyen dang bral bas de gnyis ka'ang ma yin pa/ sems snang la sogs pa de rnams kyang stong pa'i rang gshis las ci yang snang zhing 'gyu dran 'gag med du 'char bas de gnyis ka ma yin pa'ang ma yin pa'i stong nyid mtha' bzhi dang bral ba bsgoms kyang de nyid ma bsgom yang de nyid/

gang ltar byas kyang rjen gsal/ hrig dwangs/ 'dzin med/ gzhi bral/ kun gzhi ma thog tu slebs pa dran pa rtsol bcas la lta mi dgos pa zhig 'byung ba de tha mal gyi shes pa snying dbus su sad pa de yin| 'di dang sngar sgom 'phrang bdag 'dzin can de gnyis nor nyen che bas bla ma myong ba can gyis slob ma dad pa can la gad rta 'phrod pa shin tu gal che/ de'i ngang nas mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i rtogs pa de nyid 'dzin med rang bzhin gcer mthong shar grol gang shar kha yan du sgom zhing*/ 'dzin chags sogs dug lngas ma sbags pa'i spyod pa chu la dbyug pa brgyab pa ltar rjes med kyi ngang nas phyogs med du rgyu zhing*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi btung zhing gnas ri khyad par can rnams su phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi de nyid rtogs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par bya dang ri dwags ltar gtad med 'dzin med chags zhen med par rgyu zhing rtogs pa rgyun skyong ba la gcig por bsdad pa dang*/ mang po'i dbus su bsdad pa dang*/ rkyen bzang ngan sogs gang ltar byas kyang rtogs pa skyed pa'i grogs su 'gro ba zhig 'byung bas 'di tsam du slebs nas gzhan don bskyang na rang gzhan gnyis ka la phan pa tsam 'ong*/ rtogs pa skye lugs tsam ni rim gyis sa 'bring po tsam gyi dbang du btang la/ cig car ba dang*/ thod rgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pa rtsal che ba dang chung ba sogs la cha 'jog rgyu mi 'dug /rim pa 'di rnams rang nyams dang sbyar gyi rnal 'byor bzhi sogs nges bshad dang ma sbyar/ lar sgom chen pa'i gegs la ngar 'dzin dang*/ gzhan don dang chags zhen las che ba'i gegs rkyen med pas dus thams cad du lo 'dod/ chos brgyad/ ngar 'dzin mkhas 'dod kyi khengs pa med pa dang*/ log lta spangs nas dag snang phyogs med du sbyang ba gal che/ dam tshig ma nyams pa gal che/ dad pa che ba gal che/ rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa gal che/

nyams myong sgom stobs las 'byung gi tshig gi sbyangs stobs las mi 'byung bas nyams len dang dpe cha mi bsre ba gal che/ sngon ston pas kyang phar phyin drug rdzogs par byas shing sgom stobs las mngon par sangs rgyas kyi tha snyad dang dpe klog gis de nyid ma mthong ngo*// des na lan la mi re ba'i sbyin pa/ nges pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims| rkyen thub pa'i bzod pa/ le lo 'joms pa'i brtson 'grus/ nyon mongs kyis mi brdzi ba'i bsam gtan/ bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i shes rab rnams kyi nyams len gyis gegs sel dang bogs 'don bya/ ri khrod la sdod na bag yangs lkog nyal du ma lus pa dang*/ mang po'i dbus su dug lnga gang shar rang grol 'dzin med du gtong ba gal che che/ zhes pa mnga' ris sgrub pa bas bskul ngor rang gi nyams myong rnams yi ger bris pa ni/ 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal skya min ser min chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka med pa ming tsam la bdag gir 'dzin pa/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes mgyogs par bris pa yin gyi/ sgom pa goms pas nyams myong skye tshul 'di ni tha snyad pa rnams dang cung mi 'grig pas rtog ge ba rnams la cha ma 'tshal lo// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /chos bro bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho// nga khyod gnyis 'dzin ma dgos// rang sems gnyug ma'i chos sku// sgyu lus zhing khams dag par// ma bcos lhug par bzhugs 'dug /gang shar 'dzin med ngang nas// grag stong rdo rje'i glu dbyangs// gzhom med nā da'i drug skyes// snang stong rdo rje'i gar stabs// zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang nas| |glu gar mchod pa 'bul gyi// dga' sdug re dogs med pa'i// mchod gnas rnams la mchod do// nga rang chos kyi grags pa// rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du// bram ze rgan bur skyes tshe// 'khor 'das sems su rtogs pas// deng sang dus ngan snyigs mar// skyu ra'i rigs lus thob tshe// tshur mthong byis blo tsam du// bzang ngan ji ltar 'dug kyang*// don du rang sems sangs rgyas// 'khor bar 'khyam dogs mi 'dug

/bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems// rang sems las gzhan mi 'dug /gzhan pa'i ser gzugs bla ma// gang dga' gang bder mdzod cig /yi dam gdan gsum tshang ba// sems nyid gsal stong phyogs las// gzhan du rdul tsam mi 'dug /gru bzhi sgor mo'i dkyil 'khor// mthing spang gang dgar zhog thong*// ma sring mkha' 'gro chos skyong*// sems kyi rang rtsal kho na// kha gdangs mche gtsigs de tsho// kha rog cam me bzhugs shig /dga' dang skyid pa'i glu bro// sdug cing ngal ba'i cho nge*// chos dbyings ngang du ro gcig /dga' sdug rang sar dengs song*// sa zhing nor rdzas yul 'khor// ltar snang nyer mkho tsam las// sgyu ma g.yar po kho nar// rtogs pas a 'thas ma dgos// zhen 'khris rbad kyis chod song*// spong sems don dam rtogs pas// dmar ser 'jal 'jol gyon nas// dug sdong dar gtum ma dgos// mgo reg zhabs rjen nyams mtshar// sems byung sems su rtogs pas// mig btsum a tsa ma na'i// ltar snang snying rje brjed thal// stong nyid ngang du thal lo// rang sems lha skur grub pas// rnga rdung dril dkrol dbyangs kyi// nga ro ma dgos blo bde// dgos kyang skad stabs zhan no// tshogs drug bsgom du dga' ba// kha ngoms grod 'grangs mal sar// krong krong mnyam bzhag byas lo'i// stong nyid kha 'byams ma byung*// sgom chen spyi pa'i khyu nas// bud kyang rang blo bde bo// rlung sems gnad don gcig pas// dhū tir zhugs nas thim song*// kom gdan steng du rtsa btsir| |rkang rkyong lag rkyong ma dgos// ming snyan 'khrul 'khor bral brel// g.yas skor g.yon skor brjed ngas// rtsa rlung thig le zag med// 'pho bral dbyings su thim pas// bu chung bu mo'i thabs lam// rang btsongs rin med ma dgos// dbyings rig chos skur mthong bas// lha mthong 'dre mthong sna tshogs// ming snyan dag snang yin lo// zab zob blo brid ma shes// chos kun yin lugs shes pas// brtag dpyad mngon shes 'grib song*// 'dri rtsad 'og 'gyus bcos pa'i// lung bstan brtag pas ci bya// rgyu 'bras bslu med tshad mar// nges pa'i khu 'phrig tshud pas// u tshugs chos brgyad sbubs bcug

/de 'dra'i drang po mi shes// glen tshul 'di ka blo bde// lha dang bla mar nongs pa'i// rang gnong rdul tsam med pas// gzhan gyi ngo srung mi chos| |gdod nas ma shes dang spro// nga khyod rmi lam ji bzhin// don ngor chu dang chab rom// gnyis 'dzin rang mtshang bud pas// phyogs lhung ma dgos re skyid// gdeng tshad chags zhen snying 'thams// gzhan ngor kun spangs bya bral// dgos med zhen log ma dgos// brtan g.yo mi rtag 'dus byas// bzhugs tshul mthong bas sos dal// nga rang chos kyi grags pa// pho rgod gtam bzang dpa' bo// 'khor mang 'byor ldan grags snyan// chos tshugs 'ar rding 'ur rding*// dgra gtam 'ar gog 'ur gog /'khor slob zang nge zing nge*// tshe 'dir skyid skyid bde bde| |phyi mar ngan 'gror 'dur 'dur// de 'dra 'dod kyang gdod nas// smon lam 'phen pas ma byung*// cha lugs ci bde gang bde// dkar ser dmar tshos gang byung*// mgo skyes breg dang ral cog /bdag rkyen 'dzin stangs mi 'dug /lus kyi dal dal cam cam// ngag gi 'jam 'jam snyan snyan// sems kyi 'khor 'das mno bsam// nga yis shes kyang mi shes// byas kyang yong rigs mi 'dug /gang dga' gang bder bzhag pas// gang byung ci byung de ka /gang yong ci yong shog cig /lus ni gdan gsum lha yin// snang yul sgyu ma'i lha sku// ngag ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa// sgra grag sngags kyi rang gdangs// sems ni rang babs chos sku// gang shar rnam rtog shar grol// de las gzhan pa'i gtad so// sngags pa rgan po bdag la// rdul tsam mi 'dug e ma// sems nyid chos sku gdod nas// bde chen sdug bsngal spangs so// nga nga ngu ngu'i sdug rgya// gang bde ci bder thong dang*// sems la sdug bsngal med pas// ngag gis a kha kha ba'i// smra col 'gro gleng tshab tu// gang shar ci shar bris pa'i// gtad med rgyang glu blangs so// de lta'i rol pa shar bas// lus la bde lag yang sha| |legs legs mdzes mdzes med kyang*// lag pa gar stabs sna tshogs// rkang pa sa rgyag gnam rgyag
